The summary format excludes detailed financial calculations and audit trails while maintaining key transaction context for efficient browsing.

Each sale represents a completed purchase transaction with financial commitments, linking to the original order for tracking purposes. The summary includes commission calculations and net payout amounts for seller financial reporting, while maintaining relationships to customer and seller entities for comprehensive transaction context.

Used primarily in paginated search results where full sale details are not required, supporting both seller-specific views (filtered by seller ownership) and administrative overviews (across all sellers) with appropriate access controls.

id.description: Unique identifier for the sale transaction record. Generated automatically upon sale creation using UUID v4 for global uniqueness and security.

sale_amount.description: Total sale amount including taxes and shipping charges. Represents the gross transaction value before commission deductions and platform fees.

sale_date.description: Timestamp when the sale was finalized and recorded in the system. Used for temporal filtering and chronological ordering of transaction records.

item_count.description: Total number of distinct items sold in this transaction. Provides quick insight into transaction complexity and product diversity.

sale_status.description: Current operational status of the sale transaction. Valid values: completed (successful transaction), refunded (full or partial refund processed), disputed (customer or seller dispute active).

commission_rate.description: Platform commission percentage applied to this sale. Determines the platform's revenue share from the transaction based on seller agreement terms.

net_amount.description: Final amount payable to the seller after commission and fee deductions. Represents the seller's actual earnings from the transaction.

customer.description: Customer who made the purchase, providing essential identification and relationship context for the transaction.

seller.description: Seller who received the sale, establishing the business relationship and ownership context for transaction reporting.

order.description: Original order that generated this sale, maintaining traceability back to the customer's purchase intent and initial transaction details.

IShoppingMallSale.IRequest.description:
Search and filtering criteria for sales transaction queries across the shopping mall platform.

Provides comprehensive filtering capabilities for sales records stored in the shopping_mall_sales table, supporting complex search scenarios for business intelligence, financial reporting, and transaction analysis. The search interface accommodates both simple keyword searches and advanced multi-criteria filtering.

Supports filtering by sale status (completed, refunded, disputed), financial thresholds (amount ranges, commission rates, net amounts), temporal ranges (sale dates), and quantitative metrics (item counts). Pagination parameters control result set management for large datasets, while sorting options enable flexible result ordering.

Security considerations ensure appropriate data access based on user roles: sellers can only search their own sales transactions, while administrators have platform-wide access. All searches respect data privacy and financial confidentiality requirements.

page.description: Page number for paginated results using 1-based indexing. Determines which segment of the result set to retrieve for large datasets.

limit.description: Number of sale records to return per page. Controls result set size for performance optimization, with maximum limit of 100 records per request.

search.description: Free-text search across sale identifiers, customer names, or order references. Supports partial matching for flexible discovery of relevant transactions.

oneOf.description: Filter by specific sale status values. Enables targeted searching for transactions in particular operational states for reporting and analysis.
Filter by specific sale status values. Enables targeted searching for transactions in particular operational states for reporting and analysis.
Filter by specific sale status values. Enables targeted searching for transactions in particular operational states for reporting and analysis.

sale_status.description: Filter by specific sale status values. Enables targeted searching for transactions in particular operational states for reporting and analysis.

min_amount.description: Minimum sale amount filter (inclusive). Sets lower financial threshold for transaction value filtering in currency units.

max_amount.description: Maximum sale amount filter (inclusive). Sets upper financial threshold for transaction value filtering in currency units.

min_commission_rate.description: Minimum commission rate filter (inclusive). Enables searching for transactions with specific platform revenue share percentages.

max_commission_rate.description: Maximum commission rate filter (inclusive). Enables searching for transactions with specific platform revenue share percentages.

min_net_amount.description: Minimum net amount filter (inclusive). Targets transactions based on seller payout amounts after commission deductions.

max_net_amount.description: Maximum net amount filter (inclusive). Targets transactions based on seller payout amounts after commission deductions.

start_date.description: Start date for sale date range filter (inclusive). Defines the beginning of the temporal search window for transaction records.

end_date.description: End date for sale date range filter (inclusive). Defines the conclusion of the temporal search window for transaction records.

oneOf.description: Sort results by sale transaction timestamp for chronological ordering.
Sort results by total transaction value for financial analysis.
Sort results by number of items sold for transaction complexity assessment.
Sort results by platform commission percentage for revenue analysis.
Sort results by seller payout amount for earnings analysis.

order_by.description: Field to sort results by for organized presentation. Supports multiple sorting dimensions including temporal, financial, and quantitative metrics.

oneOf.description: Sort direction: ascending order for chronological or value-based sequencing.
Sort direction: descending order for reverse chronological or value-based sequencing.

order_direction.description: Sort direction control for result ordering. Ascending for natural sequences, descending for reverse sequences.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the order record generated automatically using UUID v4.

This identifier serves as the primary key for order tracking and reference across the shopping mall platform. Each order receives a unique ID upon creation that remains constant throughout the order lifecycle.

The ID is used for database relationships, API operations, and cross-system integration. It provides a stable reference point for order management, customer service, and financial reconciliation processes.

order_number.description:
Unique order identifier for customer reference and tracking, typically following a human-readable format.

Order numbers serve as the primary customer-facing identifier for order tracking and support inquiries. They follow a consistent pattern that may include date codes, sequence numbers, or other business-specific formatting.

This identifier is displayed on invoices, shipping labels, and customer communications. It provides a user-friendly reference that customers can easily remember and share with support teams.

total_amount.description:
Total order amount including taxes, shipping, and any additional fees in the specified currency.

Represents the final amount the customer pays for the order, calculated as subtotal + tax + shipping. This amount is used for payment processing, financial reporting, and customer billing.

The total amount reflects the complete financial commitment for the order, including all applicable charges and discounts. It must match the amount processed through payment gateways for transaction integrity.

subtotal_amount.description:
Order subtotal amount representing the sum of all item prices before taxes and shipping.

Calculated as the total of all product prices multiplied by quantities, excluding any taxes, shipping costs, or additional fees. This amount provides insight into the base product value before additional charges.

The subtotal is used for tax calculations, discount applications, and financial analysis. It helps customers understand the breakdown of their order total and provides transparency in pricing.

tax_amount.description:
Total tax amount calculated for the order based on applicable tax rates and jurisdictions.

Represents the sum of all taxes applied to the order, including sales tax, VAT, GST, or other regional taxes. Tax calculation considers the shipping address, product categories, and current tax regulations.

This amount is critical for financial compliance, tax reporting, and customer transparency. It ensures proper tax collection and remittance to relevant tax authorities.

shipping_amount.description:
Shipping cost for the order based on selected shipping method, package weight, and destination.

Calculated according to the platform's shipping rules, which may consider factors like delivery speed, package dimensions, shipping zones, and carrier rates. This amount covers the cost of order fulfillment and delivery.

Shipping costs may vary based on customer location, order size, and promotional offers. This field ensures accurate cost representation and proper carrier payment.

currency.description:
Currency code for the order following ISO 4217 standard (e.g., USD, EUR, KRW, JPY).

Specifies the currency in which all monetary amounts in the order are denominated. This ensures consistent pricing, payment processing, and financial reporting across different markets.

The currency code determines exchange rates for international transactions and affects tax calculations. It must remain consistent throughout the order lifecycle to maintain financial integrity.

status.description:
Current order status indicating the stage in the order fulfillment process.

Valid status values include: pending (order created), confirmed (payment verified), processing (preparing for shipment), shipped (dispatched to customer), delivered (received by customer), completed (finalized), cancelled (order cancelled), refunded (payment refunded).

Status tracking provides visibility into order progress for customers, sellers, and administrators. Each status transition triggers appropriate notifications and workflow actions.

shipping_address.description:
Complete shipping address for order delivery including street, city, state/province, postal code, and country.

Contains the formatted address where the order should be delivered. This information is used for carrier routing, delivery confirmation, and customer verification.

The shipping address must be validated for deliverability and may include special instructions or delivery preferences. It serves as the primary location for physical order fulfillment.

billing_address.description:
Billing address for payment processing and invoice generation, typically matching the customer's payment method address.

Used for payment verification, fraud detection, and tax jurisdiction determination. The billing address may differ from the shipping address for gift orders or business purchases.

This address is critical for payment authorization and financial compliance. It ensures that billing information matches the customer's payment method for transaction security.

created_at.description:
Order creation timestamp indicating when the customer completed the checkout process.

Recorded automatically when the order transitions from shopping cart to confirmed purchase. This timestamp serves as the official order date for reporting, analytics, and customer service.

The creation time helps track order processing efficiency, seasonal trends, and customer behavior patterns. It provides a reference point for order aging and fulfillment timelines.

updated_at.description:
Last order update timestamp tracking when any order information was modified.

Updated automatically whenever order details change, including status transitions, address updates, or amount adjustments. This field provides audit trail capabilities for order management.

The update timestamp helps identify recent activity, track fulfillment progress, and troubleshoot order issues. It ensures data consistency across order lifecycle events.

customer.description:
Customer who placed the order, providing essential context for order identification and customer relationship management.

References the customer entity that initiated the purchase, including basic identification information. This relationship enables customer-specific order history, personalized service, and targeted communications.

The customer reference supports features like order tracking, reordering, and customer support. It maintains the connection between orders and customer accounts while respecting privacy boundaries in summary views.

IShoppingMallOrder.ISummary.description:
Summary view of shopping mall orders optimized for list displays and quick reference.

Provides essential order information including order identification, financial details, status tracking, and customer context. This summary format excludes detailed item breakdowns and extensive customer information to maintain performance in list views while providing sufficient context for order management.

Used primarily for order listing operations where full order details are not required, such as customer order history pages, administrative dashboards, and search results. The summary balances information density with performance considerations.

The order summary supports efficient order tracking, customer service workflows, and business analytics. It enables quick assessment of order status, financial metrics, and customer relationships without loading complete order records.

IShoppingMallCustomer.ISummary.description:
Compact customer representation for list views, search results, and relationship references.

Provides essential customer identification information while excluding sensitive data like passwords and detailed contact information. This summary format optimizes performance for customer listing operations while maintaining sufficient context for customer identification and relationship management.

Used in administrative interfaces, customer search results, order references, and relationship contexts where full customer profiles are not required. The summary prevents information overload while supporting efficient customer management workflows.

Customer orders and detailed profiles are accessed via separate endpoints to maintain security boundaries and performance optimization. This approach ensures that customer data is presented appropriately based on context and access permissions.

id.description:
Unique customer identifier generated automatically using UUID v4 for secure reference.

Serves as the primary key for customer identification across the shopping mall platform. This identifier remains constant throughout the customer lifecycle and supports secure data relationships.

The customer ID enables efficient database operations, API integrations, and cross-system references while maintaining customer privacy. It provides a stable reference point for all customer-related activities.

email.description:
Customer email address used for authentication, communication, and account identification.

Serves as the primary contact method for order notifications, marketing communications, and account recovery. Email addresses must be unique across the platform and validated for format correctness.

This field supports customer identification, communication workflows, and account management. It ensures that customers can be reached for important updates and service communications.

first_name.description:
Customer's first name for personalization, order processing, and customer service interactions.

Used to personalize communications, verify order details, and provide friendly customer service. First names help create a personalized shopping experience and build customer relationships.

This information supports order verification, shipping label generation, and customer support workflows. It enhances the customer experience through personalized interactions.

last_name.description:
Customer's last name for complete identification, order verification, and professional communication.

Provides the full customer name for order processing, shipping documentation, and formal communications. Last names help distinguish between customers with similar first names and support accurate record keeping.

Combined with the first name, this field enables proper customer identification and supports business processes requiring full customer names.

phone_number.description:
Customer contact phone number for order updates, delivery coordination, and support communications.

Optional contact information that provides an alternative communication channel for time-sensitive updates. Phone numbers may be used for delivery notifications, fraud prevention, and urgent support situations.

This field enhances customer service capabilities by providing multiple contact methods. It supports delivery coordination and urgent communication needs when email is insufficient.

status.description:
Customer account status indicating the current state of the customer's platform access.

Valid status values include: active (fully functional account), suspended (temporarily restricted), pending_verification (awaiting email confirmation). Status management supports account security, compliance, and customer service workflows.

This field enables appropriate access control, communication handling, and account management. It ensures that customer accounts are managed according to platform policies and security requirements.

created_at.description:
Customer account creation timestamp indicating when the customer registered on the platform.

Recorded automatically during customer registration and serves as the official account creation date. This timestamp supports customer lifecycle analysis, retention tracking, and account management.

The creation date helps identify new customers, track platform growth, and analyze customer behavior patterns. It provides context for customer relationship duration and engagement history.

updated_at.description:
Last customer account update timestamp tracking when account information was modified.

Updated automatically whenever customer profile details change, including personal information, preferences, or status updates. This field supports account management and data integrity.

The update timestamp helps identify recent account activity, track profile changes, and maintain audit trails. It ensures that customer information remains current and accurately reflected across the platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the shopping cart session. Generated automatically using UUID v4 when the cart is created. Used as the primary key for cart operations and references throughout the shopping platform.

shopping_mall_customer_session_id.description:
Foreign key reference to the customer session that owns this shopping cart.

This field establishes the ownership relationship between the cart and the authenticated customer session. Each cart must be associated with exactly one active customer session, ensuring proper access control and data isolation between different customers.

The system validates that the referenced customer session exists and is active before allowing cart operations. This relationship enables features like cart persistence across browser sessions and multi-device shopping continuity.

status.description:
Current cart status indicating the shopping session state and lifecycle phase.

Valid values: active, abandoned, converted, expired. Active carts represent currently active shopping sessions where customers are actively adding or modifying products. Abandoned carts were not converted to orders within the configured timeout period. Converted carts successfully became orders through the checkout process. Expired carts were automatically cleaned up after exceeding the maximum session duration.

The cart lifecycle follows strict state transitions: active → abandoned/converted/expired. System administrators can monitor cart status for analytics on shopping behavior and conversion rates.

expires_at.description:
Timestamp when this cart will automatically expire if not converted to an order.

Used for cleaning up abandoned carts and managing cart lifecycle. The expiration timestamp is calculated based on system configuration when the cart is created and may be extended during active shopping sessions.

The system automatically removes expired carts to maintain database performance and data hygiene. Customers receive notifications before cart expiration to encourage order completion.

applied_coupon_code.description:
Coupon code currently applied to this cart for discount calculations.

References active promotions and discount codes that customers have applied to their shopping session. Null if no coupon is currently applied. The system validates coupon codes against active promotions, checking expiration dates, usage limits, and eligibility criteria.

Coupon applications affect cart totals and may have restrictions based on product categories, minimum purchase amounts, or customer segments. Invalid or expired coupons are automatically removed during cart updates.

shipping_method.description:
Selected shipping method for this cart session.

Used to pre-calculate shipping costs during the shopping experience and provide accurate total cost estimates to customers. Shipping methods include standard, express, overnight, and international options with varying delivery times and costs.

The system validates shipping method availability based on cart contents, destination address, and seller shipping policies. Customers can change shipping methods before order conversion, which updates the estimated shipping cost accordingly.

estimated_shipping_cost.description:
Pre-calculated shipping cost based on selected method and cart contents.

Helps customers understand total costs during shopping and provides accurate pricing information before order conversion. The cost is calculated dynamically based on cart weight, dimensions, destination, and selected shipping method.

Shipping costs are estimates and may be adjusted during order processing based on actual carrier rates and packaging requirements. The system recalculates shipping costs whenever cart contents or shipping methods change.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when the cart was initially created.

Used for cart lifecycle tracking, shopping behavior analytics, and session management across the platform. The creation timestamp helps identify new shopping sessions and track customer engagement patterns.

System administrators use creation timestamps for analytics on cart creation rates, peak shopping hours, and seasonal shopping trends. The timestamp is automatically set when the cart is first created and cannot be modified.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp when the cart was last modified.

Helps identify active shopping sessions and track customer engagement with their shopping cart. The updated_at timestamp is automatically refreshed whenever any cart property changes, including item additions, quantity updates, or preference modifications.

This field is crucial for identifying abandoned carts (no updates within configured timeout) and optimizing cart cleanup processes. Frequent updates indicate high customer engagement with the shopping experience.

deleted_at.description:
Timestamp when the cart was soft-deleted for data preservation.

Preserves cart data for analytics and reporting purposes while removing it from active shopping session management. Soft deletion allows the system to maintain historical shopping data for business intelligence while keeping active operations performant.

Deleted carts are excluded from normal cart queries but remain accessible for administrative reporting and customer service inquiries. The deletion timestamp is set when customers explicitly delete their cart or when automated cleanup processes remove expired carts.

IShoppingMallCart.description:
Shopping cart sessions that temporarily hold customer product selections before order conversion.

Each cart represents a unique shopping session associated with a customer's active session. Carts maintain temporary product selections that customers may later convert to actual orders or abandon. The system tracks cart creation, modification, and expiration to manage abandoned carts and optimize shopping experiences.

Carts are automatically created when customers add their first product and persist for configurable periods to support guest shopping and session recovery. Each cart is linked to a specific customer session and contains metadata about the shopping context including applied coupons, shipping preferences, and expiration management.

The cart lifecycle includes active, abandoned, converted, and expired states, with automatic cleanup of expired carts to maintain system performance. Active carts represent ongoing shopping sessions, abandoned carts indicate incomplete purchases, converted carts successfully completed the checkout process, and expired carts were automatically removed after inactivity.

Carts support features like multi-product selection, coupon applications, shipping method selection, and real-time cost calculations. The system ensures data isolation between different customer sessions and provides comprehensive cart management capabilities through the shopping platform API.

shopping_mall_customer_session_id.description:
Foreign key reference to the customer session that will own this shopping cart.

This field establishes the ownership relationship between the new cart and the authenticated customer session. The system validates that the referenced customer session exists, is active, and belongs to the authenticated user before creating the cart.

Security considerations require that customers can only create carts for their own sessions. The customer session ID is typically extracted from the JWT token during authentication and should match the provided session ID to prevent unauthorized cart creation.

shipping_method.description:
Selected shipping method for this cart.

Used to pre-calculate shipping costs during shopping and provide accurate total cost estimates. Shipping methods are validated against available options based on the customer's location and cart contents.

If no shipping method is specified, the system may apply a default method based on customer preferences or platform configuration. Shipping method selection affects the estimated shipping cost calculation during cart creation.

applied_coupon_code.description:
Coupon code to apply to this cart, if any.

References active promotions for discount calculations during shopping. The system validates coupon codes against active promotions, checking expiration dates, usage limits, and eligibility criteria before application.

Invalid or expired coupons are rejected during cart creation. Coupon applications may affect product eligibility and cart totals based on promotion rules and restrictions.

IShoppingMallCart.ICreate.description:
Shopping cart creation data for initializing a new shopping session.

This DTO contains customer-configurable options for cart setup including shipping preferences and coupon applications. System-managed fields like status, expiration timestamps, and unique identifiers are handled automatically by the backend during cart creation.

The cart creation process validates coupon codes, shipping method availability, and customer session validity before creating the cart session. Security measures ensure that carts can only be created for authenticated customer sessions with proper authorization.

Required fields include the customer session reference to establish cart ownership. Optional fields allow customers to pre-configure shipping preferences and apply promotional coupons during cart initialization. The system sets default values for status (active) and calculates expiration timestamps based on platform configuration.

Cart creation typically occurs when customers add their first product to the shopping session or explicitly initiate a new cart through the shopping interface. The operation returns the complete cart details including system-generated fields like the unique cart identifier and creation timestamp.

page.description:
Page number for paginated results. Starts from 1 for the first page of cart search results.

Used to navigate through large sets of cart data efficiently while maintaining optimal system performance.

limit.description:
Number of cart records to return per page. Maximum limit of 100 items ensures optimal performance for cart search operations.

Smaller limits improve response times for large cart datasets, while larger limits provide more comprehensive results per request.

status.description:
Filter by cart status to narrow search results to specific cart lifecycle stages.

Valid values: active (currently being used), abandoned (not converted to orders), converted (successfully became orders), expired (automatically cleaned up).

This filter helps administrators focus on carts requiring attention or analysis based on their current state.

created_at_start.description:
Start date for filtering carts created within a specific date range. Uses ISO 8601 format for precise timestamp filtering.

Helps administrators analyze cart creation patterns and identify trends over specific time periods for business intelligence.

created_at_end.description:
End date for filtering carts created within a specific date range. Combined with created_at_start for precise temporal analysis.

Enables administrators to focus on carts created during specific business periods or promotional campaigns.

expires_at_start.description:
Start date for filtering carts expiring within a specific date range. Useful for identifying carts approaching expiration.

Supports proactive cart management and abandoned cart recovery initiatives by targeting carts nearing expiration.

expires_at_end.description:
End date for filtering carts expiring within a specific date range. Helps administrators monitor cart expiration patterns.

Enables analysis of cart lifecycle durations and optimization of expiration policies based on historical data.

shipping_method.description:
Filter by specific shipping method selected for carts. Allows analysis of shipping preference patterns across customer segments.

Helps administrators understand which shipping options are most popular and optimize shipping strategy accordingly.

applied_coupon_code.description:
Filter by specific coupon code applied to carts. Enables analysis of coupon effectiveness and redemption patterns.

Supports marketing campaign evaluation by tracking which promotions are driving cart creation and conversion.

customer_session_id.description:
Filter by specific customer session identifier to retrieve carts associated with particular shopping sessions.

Enables customer service scenarios where administrators need to review specific customer cart activity for support purposes.

IShoppingMallCart.IRequest.description:
Search criteria and pagination parameters for cart filtering operations in the shopping mall platform.

This DTO provides comprehensive search functionality for shopping cart sessions with support for filtering by cart status, creation dates, expiration timelines, shipping methods, applied coupons, and customer session associations. Pagination parameters ensure efficient browsing of large cart datasets while maintaining system performance.

Date range filters support both creation and expiration timelines, allowing for targeted searches based on cart lifecycle stages. The operation is designed for administrative oversight and customer service scenarios where cart analytics and session management are required.

Security considerations ensure that customers can only search their own cart sessions, while administrative users may access broader cart data for system analytics and abandoned cart recovery initiatives. The operation supports complex query structures while maintaining data privacy and access control boundaries.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the shopping cart session. Generated automatically using UUID v4 format upon cart creation.

Serves as the primary key for cart identification and provides unique reference for cart management operations.

status.description:
Current cart status indicating the shopping session state and lifecycle position.

Valid values: active (currently being used), abandoned (not converted to orders), converted (successfully became orders), expired (automatically cleaned up).

Provides quick status overview for list displays and summary views, enabling efficient cart management and analytics.

expires_at.description:
Timestamp when this cart will automatically expire if not converted to an order. Uses ISO 8601 format for consistency.

Used for quick expiration checking and cart lifecycle management in summary views. Supports proactive cart recovery initiatives.

applied_coupon_code.description:
Currently applied coupon code for discount calculations. References active promotions applied to the shopping session.

Shows active promotions applied to the shopping session for quick reference and supports coupon effectiveness analysis.

shipping_method.description:
Selected shipping method for this cart. Used to display shipping preferences and calculate shipping costs during shopping.

Provides insight into customer shipping preferences and helps optimize shipping strategy based on popular choices.

estimated_shipping_cost.description:
Pre-calculated shipping cost based on selected method and cart contents. Helps customers understand total costs during shopping.

Displayed in summary views to provide quick cost overview without requiring detailed cart item calculations.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when the cart was initially created. Uses ISO 8601 format for temporal consistency.

Provides creation context for cart management and session tracking, enabling analysis of cart creation patterns.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp when the cart was last modified. Helps identify active shopping sessions and recent cart activity.

Supports cart lifecycle analysis by tracking modification patterns and identifying carts with recent customer engagement.

IShoppingMallCart.ISummary.description:
Summary view of shopping cart sessions optimized for list displays and quick reference in the shopping mall platform.

Provides essential cart information without the full detail set, optimized for performance in list views and summary displays. Includes key metadata for cart management, status tracking, and lifecycle analysis.

This summary representation supports administrative oversight by providing quick access to critical cart attributes while maintaining system performance. The compact format enables efficient browsing of large cart datasets during search operations and analytics reporting.

Security considerations ensure that summary information respects data privacy boundaries while providing sufficient context for effective cart management and customer service scenarios.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the cart item entry. Generated automatically using UUID v4 when a new cart item is created.

This identifier is used throughout the system to uniquely reference specific product selections within shopping carts for retrieval, modification, and tracking purposes.

shopping_mall_cart_id.description:
Foreign key reference to the parent shopping cart that contains this item. Links to {@link shopping_mall_carts.id}.

This field establishes the relationship between the cart item and its parent shopping cart session, ensuring proper cart context and ownership validation for all cart operations.

shopping_mall_product_variant_id.description:
Foreign key reference to the specific product variant selected by the customer. Links to {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

This field connects the cart item to the exact product variant chosen by the customer, including specific attributes like size, color, or other variant options.

quantity.description:
Number of units of this product variant selected by the customer.

Validated against available inventory with maximum limit of 999 per item to prevent overselling and ensure reasonable order quantities.

The system performs real-time inventory validation to ensure the requested quantity is available before adding items to the cart.

unit_price.description:
Price per unit at the time the item was added to the cart.

Preserves pricing for abandoned cart recovery and maintains shopping context even if product prices change later.

This price capture mechanism ensures customers see consistent pricing throughout their shopping session, preventing price fluctuations from affecting items already in the cart.

added_at.description:
Timestamp when this item was originally added to the cart.

Helps track shopping behavior patterns and understand customer product selection timing.

This timestamp is used for cart analytics, abandoned cart recovery campaigns, and understanding customer shopping habits.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp when this item was last modified.

Tracks cart activity and item modifications such as quantity changes or special instructions updates.

The system automatically updates this timestamp whenever cart item properties are modified to maintain accurate activity tracking.

notes.description:
Optional customer notes or special instructions for this specific cart item.

Useful for personalized orders, gift messages, or specific product requirements that customers want to communicate.

Notes can include special packaging requests, gift messages, product customization instructions, or any other customer-specific requirements.

IShoppingMallCartItem.description:
Individual product selections within shopping carts, representing customer's temporary product choices.

Each cart item links a specific product variant to a shopping cart with selected quantity. Items capture the product selection at the time of addition, including current price, to maintain shopping context even if product details change later.

Cart items support product variants for size, color, or other attribute selections, and maintain real-time inventory validation to prevent overselling. The system tracks item additions, modifications, and removals to provide accurate cart context.

Items are automatically removed when their parent cart expires or is converted to an order, with historical preservation for analytics and customer behavior analysis. The cart item entity maintains relationships with shopping carts and product variants through foreign key references.

This entity plays a crucial role in the shopping experience by preserving customer selections, maintaining pricing consistency, and supporting inventory management throughout the shopping session lifecycle.

cart_id.description:
Unique identifier of the target shopping cart where the item will be added.

This field establishes the relationship between the new cart item and its parent shopping cart session.

The cart ID is typically provided via URL path parameter in API operations, but included here for complete creation context.

product_variant_id.description:
Unique identifier of the specific product variant to add to the cart.

References the exact product variant selected by the customer, including specific attributes and pricing.

The system validates that this product variant exists and has sufficient inventory before creating the cart item.

quantity.description:
Number of units of this product variant to add.

Must be between 1 and 999, validated against available inventory to prevent overselling.

The system performs real-time inventory checks to ensure the requested quantity is available.

notes.description:
Optional customer notes or special instructions for this cart item.

Can include gift messages, special packaging requests, or product customization instructions.

Notes are preserved with the cart item and can be referenced during order processing.

IShoppingMallCartItem.ICreate.description:
Request data for adding a new product item to a shopping cart.

This DTO captures the essential information needed to create a cart item, including product variant selection and desired quantity. The operation validates that the product variant exists and has sufficient inventory before creating the cart item.

Unit price is captured automatically from the product variant's current pricing at the time of addition to maintain pricing consistency throughout the shopping session. The system performs real-time inventory validation to prevent overselling and ensure order feasibility.

Security validation ensures that customers can only add items to their own shopping carts, with proper authentication and authorization checks performed server-side. Cart ownership is verified based on the authenticated user's session context.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the customer authentication session.

Primary key that uniquely identifies each customer session record in the system. Used for session tracking, audit purposes, and linking session data to customer activities.

The UUID format ensures global uniqueness and prevents collision across distributed systems.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when the customer session was created and authentication was established.

Records the exact moment when the customer successfully authenticated and the session was initialized. This timestamp is crucial for session expiration calculations and security monitoring.

Used for audit trails to track customer login patterns and session duration analysis.

IShoppingMallCustomerSession.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of customer authentication sessions for audit and tracking purposes.

Provides essential session information for maintaining the connection between customer activities and their authentication context. Each session represents a distinct login instance with its own security context and expiration timeline.

Used primarily in order contexts to maintain audit trails and ensure accountability for customer actions. The summary format excludes detailed connection information for efficiency in list displays and reference purposes.

Sessions are managed through authentication flows and provide temporal context for customer activities on the platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the product variant.

variant_name.description: Descriptive name for the variant (e.g., Large Blue Shirt).

sku.description: Unique SKU for this specific variant.

price.description: Variant-specific price (overrides product price if different).

stock_quantity.description: Inventory quantity specific to this variant.

active.description: Whether this variant is available for purchase.

IShoppingMallProductVariant.ISummary.description:
Summary view of product variations with different attributes.

Provides essential variant information for list displays and summary views. Includes pricing, inventory status, and basic variant details without the full attribute complexity.

Used when displaying variant information in product listings, inventory management interfaces, and summary views where detailed variant configurations are not required.

status.description:
Updated cart status indicating the current state of the shopping session.

Valid values include: 'active', 'abandoned', 'converted'. Status changes must follow valid cart lifecycle transitions and respect business rules.

Active carts represent currently active shopping sessions that customers can modify. Abandoned carts indicate sessions that were not converted to orders within the expiration period. Converted carts represent successful order conversions.

The system validates status transitions to ensure data integrity and prevent invalid state changes.

oneOf.description: Updated shipping method for this cart session.
Remove shipping method selection from this cart.

shipping_method.description:
Updated shipping method for this cart session.

Used to recalculate shipping costs based on the selected method and provide accurate total cost estimates.

Customers can change shipping preferences during the shopping experience, and the system validates method availability and calculates corresponding shipping costs.

Set to null to remove the current shipping method selection and revert to default shipping calculations.

oneOf.description: Updated coupon code to apply to this cart.
Remove coupon application from this cart.

applied_coupon_code.description:
Updated coupon code to apply to this cart for discount calculations.

References active promotions and validates coupon eligibility before application.

The system checks coupon validity, expiration dates, usage limits, and customer eligibility before applying discounts.

Set to null to remove the current coupon application and recalculate cart totals without discounts.

estimated_shipping_cost.description:
Updated estimated shipping cost based on selected method and cart contents.

Provides pre-calculated shipping cost estimates that help customers understand total costs during shopping.

The system recalculates shipping costs whenever cart contents or shipping methods change to maintain accurate pricing information.

IShoppingMallCart.IUpdate.description:
Shopping cart update data for modifying existing cart sessions with comprehensive preference management.

This DTO allows customers to update various cart preferences including status, shipping methods, coupon applications, and shipping cost estimates. System-managed fields like expiration timestamps, customer session references, and creation dates cannot be modified through this DTO to maintain data integrity.

The update process validates all modifications against business rules, including coupon code validity, shipping method availability, and cart lifecycle constraints. Customers can only modify their own active carts, and the system performs comprehensive validation before applying changes.

Security considerations ensure that customers cannot modify system-managed fields or access carts belonging to other users. The DTO supports partial updates, allowing customers to modify specific preferences without affecting other cart properties.

page.description:
Page number for paginated results, starting from 1.

Used to navigate through large sets of cart items efficiently. The system returns a specific page of results based on this parameter.

Page numbers start at 1, and invalid page numbers return appropriate error responses. The pagination system ensures consistent navigation through cart item collections.

limit.description:
Number of items per page for pagination control.

Controls the size of result sets returned by the search operation. Larger limits return more items per page but may impact performance.

The system enforces reasonable limits to maintain performance and prevent excessive resource usage during cart item searches.

search.description:
Search term to filter cart items by product name, variant attributes, or SKU information.

Supports text-based searching across product-related fields to help customers quickly find specific items in their cart.

The search functionality performs case-insensitive matching and supports partial matches for flexible filtering capabilities.

quantity_min.description:
Minimum quantity filter for cart items.

Filters cart items based on the selected quantity range. Only items with quantities greater than or equal to this value are included in results.

Useful for finding items with specific quantity thresholds or filtering out low-quantity selections.

quantity_max.description:
Maximum quantity filter for cart items.

Filters cart items based on the selected quantity range. Only items with quantities less than or equal to this value are included in results.

Helps identify items with specific quantity ranges or filter out high-quantity selections.

price_min.description:
Minimum unit price filter for cart items.

Filters items based on price thresholds. Only items with unit prices greater than or equal to this value are included.

Useful for finding higher-priced items or filtering based on price ranges during cart review.

price_max.description:
Maximum unit price filter for cart items.

Filters items based on price thresholds. Only items with unit prices less than or equal to this value are included.

Helps identify items within specific price ranges or filter out expensive selections.

added_after.description:
Filter cart items added after this specific timestamp.

Returns only items that were added to the cart after the specified date and time.

Useful for reviewing recent additions to the cart or filtering based on shopping session timing.

added_before.description:
Filter cart items added before this specific timestamp.

Returns only items that were added to the cart before the specified date and time.

Helps identify older cart items or filter based on historical shopping patterns.

oneOf.description: Sort results by the date and time when items were added to the cart.
Sort results by the unit price of cart items.
Sort results by the quantity of items selected.

sort_by.description:
Field to sort the cart item results by.

Determines the primary sorting criteria for the search results. Available options include sorting by addition date, unit price, or item quantity.

The sorting functionality helps organize cart items for better review and management during the shopping experience.

oneOf.description: Sort results in ascending order.
Sort results in descending order.

order.description:
Sort order for the cart item results.

Specifies whether results should be sorted in ascending or descending order based on the selected sort_by field.

Ascending order starts with the smallest values, while descending order starts with the largest values.

notes.description:
Filter cart items containing specific text in their notes field.

Searches for items that have customer notes matching the provided text. Supports partial matching and case-insensitive searches.

Useful for finding items with specific instructions or special requests that customers have added to their cart selections.

IShoppingMallCartItem.IRequest.description:
Search and filtering parameters for retrieving cart items from a shopping cart with comprehensive query capabilities.

This DTO provides advanced filtering and search functionality for cart item management, including pagination, quantity ranges, price thresholds, date-based filtering, sorting options, and text search capabilities. Customers can use these parameters to efficiently navigate and review their cart contents during the shopping experience.

The search system integrates with the shopping_mall_cart_items database table and leverages proper indexing for optimal performance. The DTO supports complex query combinations while maintaining reasonable response times through query optimization and result limiting.

Security considerations ensure that customers can only search within their own carts, and the system validates access rights before returning any cart item information. The filtering capabilities help customers manage large cart collections and find specific items quickly.

id.description: Unique identifier for the cart item entry. Generated automatically when the cart item is created and used for referencing specific product selections within shopping carts.

quantity.description:
Number of units of this product variant selected by the customer. Validated against available inventory with maximum limit of 999 per item to prevent overselling and ensure reasonable order quantities.

Provides quick quantity reference for cart item management and summary displays while maintaining inventory validation constraints.

unit_price.description:
Price per unit at the time the item was added to the cart. Preserves pricing for abandoned cart recovery and maintains shopping context even if product prices change later.

This price is captured at the moment of cart addition to prevent price fluctuations from affecting items already in the shopping cart, ensuring consistent shopping experience.

added_at.description:
Timestamp when this item was originally added to the cart. Helps track shopping behavior patterns and understand customer product selection timing.

Provides timing context for shopping behavior analysis in summary views and cart management interfaces.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp when this item was last modified. Tracks cart activity and item modifications such as quantity changes or special instructions updates.

Helps identify recent cart activity and understand customer engagement patterns in summary views.

notes.description:
Optional customer notes or special instructions for this specific cart item. Useful for personalized orders, gift messages, or specific product requirements that customers want to communicate.

This field allows customers to add special instructions that will be preserved throughout the shopping session and carried forward to the order if converted.

cart.description:
Parent shopping cart that contains this item. Provides complete cart context including cart status, customer information, and cart-level metadata.

This reference establishes the relationship between cart items and their parent shopping cart, enabling proper cart item display and management within the shopping session context.

product_variant.description:
Specific product variant selected by the customer. Provides complete product context including product name, variant attributes, current pricing, and availability information.

This reference connects the cart item to the specific product variant configuration chosen by the customer, enabling proper product identification and variant-specific information display.

IShoppingMallCartItem.ISummary.description:
Summary view of cart items for quick reference and list displays in shopping cart management interfaces.

Provides essential cart item information optimized for performance in summary views and list displays. Includes key metadata for cart item management and shopping session tracking while maintaining referential integrity with parent cart and product variant entities.

This summary DTO excludes detailed cart and product variant information that would be redundant in list views, focusing instead on the core cart item properties needed for efficient cart management and shopping session overviews. The design balances performance with sufficient context for meaningful cart item representation.

quantity.description:
New quantity for the cart item. Must be between 1 and 999, validated against available inventory to prevent overselling.

When updating quantity, the system validates that the requested amount does not exceed current product variant inventory levels. If insufficient stock is available, the operation returns an appropriate error response with current inventory information.

Quantity updates maintain the original unit_price captured when the item was first added to the cart, ensuring pricing consistency throughout the shopping session.

notes.description:
Updated customer notes or special instructions for this cart item. Allows customers to add personalized messages, gift instructions, or specific product requirements.

This field supports free-form text input for customer communication with sellers or for personal order annotations. Notes are preserved throughout the shopping session and carried forward to the order if the cart is converted.

Special characters and formatting are supported, with appropriate length validation to ensure reasonable note sizes that don't impact system performance.

IShoppingMallCartItem.IUpdate.description:
Request data for updating an existing cart item within a shopping cart, supporting partial updates for customer convenience.

This DTO allows customers to modify their product selections by updating quantity or adding notes. All fields are optional to support flexible partial updates where customers can modify only the properties they need to change.

The operation validates that the requested quantity changes are within inventory limits and maintains pricing consistency from the original addition. Cart and product variant identifiers are provided via URL path parameters and should not be included in the request body to ensure proper scoping and security.

Security validation ensures that only the cart owner can modify cart items. The system checks that the cart belongs to the authenticated user's session and that the cart item exists within that specific cart before processing any updates.

id.description: Unique identifier for the order record. Generated automatically using UUID v4 format upon order creation. Used as the primary key for database operations and API references.

order_number.description: Unique human-readable order identifier for customer reference and tracking purposes. Typically follows a sequential pattern like ORD-YYYYMMDD-NNNN for easy customer identification and support reference.

total_amount.description: Complete order total including all line items, taxes, shipping costs, and applicable discounts. Represents the final amount the customer is charged for the entire order transaction.

subtotal_amount.description: Order subtotal representing the sum of all product line items before taxes, shipping, and discounts are applied. Used for tax calculations and order breakdown analysis.

tax_amount.description: Total tax amount calculated for the order based on applicable tax rates for the shipping address jurisdiction. Includes sales tax, VAT, or other regional tax requirements.

shipping_amount.description: Shipping cost calculated for the order based on shipping method, package weight, destination, and carrier rates. May include handling fees and insurance costs.

currency.description: Currency code for the order using ISO 4217 format (e.g., USD, EUR, KRW). Determines pricing display and payment processing currency for international transactions.

status.description: Current order status tracking the fulfillment lifecycle. Valid values include: pending (awaiting payment), confirmed (payment received), processing (preparing for shipment), shipped (in transit), delivered (completed), cancelled (voided), refunded (return processed).

shipping_address.description: Complete shipping address for order delivery including recipient name, street address, city, state/province, postal code, and country. Used for carrier label generation and delivery coordination.

billing_address.description: Billing address for payment processing and invoice generation. Must match payment method requirements and may be used for tax jurisdiction determination.

created_at.description: Order creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format. Records when the customer completed the checkout process and the order was officially placed in the system.

updated_at.description: Last order update timestamp in ISO 8601 format. Tracks when any modification was made to the order, including status changes, address updates, or administrative adjustments.

deleted_at.description: Soft delete timestamp for order archival in ISO 8601 format. When populated, indicates the order has been marked for deletion while preserving the record for audit and reporting purposes.

customer.description: Customer who placed the order, providing essential identification and contact information. Includes customer name, status, and reference for order ownership verification and customer service purposes.

customerSession.description: Customer authentication session context when the order was placed. Records the specific login session that authorized the order creation for security auditing and fraud prevention.

IShoppingMallOrder.description:
Core order entity representing customer purchases with financial commitments in the shopping mall platform.

Stores complete order information including customer details, order totals, pricing breakdown, and fulfillment status tracking. Each order represents a committed financial transaction with legal and business implications, distinguishing it from temporary shopping cart sessions. Orders support complex scenarios involving multiple sellers, split payments, international shipping, and multi-stage fulfillment workflows.

The order lifecycle is comprehensively tracked from initial creation through final delivery or cancellation. Status transitions trigger business logic including inventory updates, payment processing, notification systems, and reporting updates. Orders maintain financial integrity through immutable pricing records and comprehensive audit trails.

Foreign key relationships are transformed into object references for efficient API consumption, allowing complete order information retrieval in a single request while maintaining proper database normalization. This eliminates the need for additional API calls to fetch customer and session details separately.

page.description: Page number for pagination control, starting from 1. Determines which set of results to return when browsing through multiple pages of order search results.

limit.description: Number of order records to return per page for pagination. Controls result set size with a maximum limit of 100 records per page to maintain API performance.

search.description: Search term for partial matching on order numbers. Supports text-based order lookup using partial order number matching for customer reference and support purposes.

status.description: Filter by specific order status value. Allows customers to view orders in particular states such as pending, shipped, or delivered for focused order management.

date_from.description: Start date for order creation date range filtering in ISO 8601 format. Enables customers to search orders placed within specific time periods for historical review.

date_to.description: End date for order creation date range filtering in ISO 8601 format. Combined with date_from to define a complete time range for order search operations.

min_amount.description: Minimum total amount filter for order value searching. Allows customers to find orders above a specific monetary threshold for financial analysis.

max_amount.description: Maximum total amount filter for order value searching. Combined with min_amount to define a monetary range for targeted order retrieval.

oneOf.description: Sort results by order creation timestamp for chronological ordering.
Sort results by last update timestamp for recent activity ordering.
Sort results by order total amount for financial value ordering.
Sort results by order number for alphanumeric sequencing.

order_by.description: Field specification for sorting search results. Determines the primary ordering criterion for the returned order list based on customer preference.

oneOf.description: Ascending sort direction from smallest to largest values.
Descending sort direction from largest to smallest values.

order_direction.description: Sort direction specification for search results. Controls whether results are returned in ascending or descending order based on the order_by field.

IShoppingMallOrder.IRequest.description:
Search criteria and pagination parameters for customer order filtering operations.

Provides comprehensive filtering capabilities for customer order searches, supporting multiple search dimensions including status-based filtering, date ranges, monetary value ranges, and text-based order number matching. The search functionality is designed for efficient customer self-service order management without requiring administrative assistance.

Security considerations are paramount - customer authentication context is automatically applied from JWT tokens, ensuring customers can only search their own orders. This eliminates the need for customer-specific filtering parameters in the request body, preventing unauthorized access to other customers' order data.

The search operation supports complex pagination with configurable page sizes and multiple sorting options. Partial matching on order numbers enables flexible search capabilities while exact status filtering provides precise order management functionality. Date range queries support historical order analysis and reporting needs.

IShoppingMallOrder.ICreate.description:
Order creation data including items, customer information, and shipping details.

Used for creating new shopping mall orders from customer shopping carts or direct purchases. This DTO includes essential business information needed to initiate a financial transaction while allowing the server to handle authentication context and system-generated fields.

Financial calculations (total amount, subtotal, taxes, shipping) are performed server-side based on current product pricing and tax rules. Customer authentication context is established through JWT token validation, ensuring proper ownership attribution.

System-generated fields (order_number, status) are managed by the backend to maintain data integrity. The operation validates product availability, calculates pricing including taxes and shipping, and establishes the order record with proper financial integrity.

currency.description: Currency code for the order (e.g., USD, EUR, KRW). Required for international transactions. Must be a valid ISO 4217 currency code supported by the payment processing system.

shipping_address.description: Complete shipping address for order delivery. Must include recipient name, street address, city, postal code, and country. Validated against address verification services to ensure deliverability.

billing_address.description: Billing address for payment processing. Must match payment method requirements and pass address verification for fraud prevention.

items.description: Order items representing products being purchased. Each item must specify product variant, quantity, and seller. Minimum 1 item required for valid order creation.

IShoppingMallOrder.IUpdate.description:
Limited order update data for modifying mutable order attributes.

Used for updating existing shopping mall orders with new information. This DTO restricts modifications to fields that can be safely changed without compromising transaction integrity.

Financial fields (order number, total amount, subtotal, taxes, shipping) are immutable to maintain financial accuracy. Ownership fields and system-generated timestamps cannot be modified after order creation.

The operation validates that the order exists and that the requesting user has permission to modify specific fields. Status changes may trigger additional business logic such as notifications or inventory updates.

status.description: Updated order status. Only administrators can modify certain status transitions. Valid status values include: pending, confirmed, processing, shipped, delivered, completed, cancelled, refunded.

shipping_address.description: Updated shipping address for order delivery. Only modifiable before shipment processing. Must pass address validation and may require additional verification for security.

billing_address.description: Updated billing address for payment processing. Subject to payment gateway validation and fraud detection checks.

shopping_mall_product_variant_id.description:
Unique identifier of the specific product variant being ordered. References the exact product variant that the customer wants to add to their order. This field is required to identify which product variant the customer is purchasing and ensures the correct product configuration is selected.

The system validates that the referenced product variant exists, is active, and has sufficient inventory before allowing order creation. The product variant ID establishes the relationship between the order item and the specific product configuration chosen by the customer.

quantity.description:
Quantity of the product variant to be ordered. Must be a positive integer value representing how many units of the product variant the customer wants to purchase.

The quantity is validated against available inventory levels to prevent overselling. Minimum quantity is 1, as orders cannot contain zero or negative quantities. The quantity directly affects the total price calculation and inventory management.

IShoppingMallOrderItem.ICreate.description:
Data required to create a new order item within an existing shopping mall order.

This DTO captures the essential information needed to add a product item to an order. The parent order ID is provided via the API path parameter (/orders/{orderId}/items) and should not be duplicated in the request body to maintain clean API design and prevent data redundancy.

The operation validates that the product variant exists and is available for purchase. The unit price and total price are calculated server-side based on the current product variant pricing at the time of order creation, ensuring pricing consistency and preventing client-side manipulation.

Note that seller information is determined from the product variant relationship and does not need to be specified separately in the request body. Authentication context fields (shopping_mall_customer_id, shopping_mall_customer_session_id) are properly excluded as they come from the authenticated JWT token, maintaining security best practices.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the order item. Generated automatically when the order item is created and serves as the primary key for order item operations.

Used for referencing specific order items in API operations and maintaining data integrity across the system. The UUID format ensures global uniqueness and prevents collision across distributed systems.

shopping_mall_order_id.description:
Foreign key reference to the parent order containing this item. Links the order item to its parent order record for proper order composition and relationship management.

This field establishes the hierarchical relationship between orders and their constituent items, enabling efficient querying and management of order contents.

shopping_mall_product_variant_id.description:
Foreign key reference to the specific product variant ordered. Preserves the exact product configuration selected by the customer at the time of purchase.

This relationship ensures historical accuracy by maintaining a reference to the product variant as it existed when the order was placed, independent of future product catalog changes.

shopping_mall_seller_id.description:
Foreign key reference to the seller who provided the product. Identifies the business entity responsible for fulfilling this specific order item.

Used for seller commission calculations, order routing, and seller-specific order management. The seller relationship is derived from the product variant association.

quantity.description:
Quantity of the product variant ordered. Represents the number of units purchased by the customer for this specific product variant.

The quantity is validated at order creation to ensure it does not exceed available inventory. This value is preserved as part of the order history and cannot be modified after order completion.

unit_price.description:
Price per unit at the time of order. Captures the exact unit price as it existed when the customer placed the order, ensuring pricing consistency for historical records.

This price is fixed at order creation and does not change even if the product variant price changes later. Used for financial calculations and customer billing accuracy.

total_price.description:
Total price for this line item (quantity * unit_price). Calculated automatically during order creation based on the quantity and unit price at that moment.

Provides the extended price for this specific order item, contributing to the overall order total. This value is preserved for financial reporting and customer billing purposes.

product_name.description:
Product name as it appeared when ordered. Preserves the exact product name from the time of purchase, ensuring historical accuracy even if product names change later.

Used for customer order history displays, invoice generation, and customer service references. This field maintains the customer's shopping experience context.

product_attributes.description:
JSON string containing product attributes at order time. Captures the complete attribute configuration selected by the customer, including size, color, style, and other variant-specific properties.

This JSON data preserves the exact product configuration as it existed at purchase time, enabling accurate order reproduction and customer service support. The attributes are stored as a JSON string for flexibility and future extensibility.

created_at.description:
Item creation timestamp. Records the exact date and time when this order item was added to the order.

Used for order timeline tracking, audit purposes, and chronological ordering of order activities. The timestamp follows ISO 8601 format for consistency.

updated_at.description:
Last item update timestamp. Tracks the most recent modification to this order item, including quantity changes or status updates.

Provides audit trail information for order item modifications and helps identify when specific changes occurred during the order lifecycle.

IShoppingMallOrderItem.description:
Individual items within an order with product details and pricing.

Represents each product line item in an order, including specific product variants, quantities, and pricing at the time of purchase. Order items maintain the exact product state as it existed when the order was placed, ensuring price consistency and product information accuracy for historical records.

Each item links to the specific product variant ordered and maintains its own pricing and quantity information separate from current product catalog data. This separation ensures that customers see exactly what they purchased, even if product information changes later. The order item serves as a snapshot of the product state at purchase time, preserving the customer's shopping experience for future reference and dispute resolution.

The entity supports complex order scenarios with items from multiple sellers and maintains financial integrity through precise pricing capture. Relationships with orders, product variants, and sellers enable comprehensive order management and efficient querying across the shopping platform.

quantity.description: Updated quantity of the product variant ordered. Must be a positive integer greater than zero. When quantity is modified, the system automatically recalculates the total price based on the original unit price.

unit_price.description: Updated unit price per product variant. Must be a non-negative value representing the price in the order's currency. Price updates may be applied due to promotions, price corrections, or customer-requested adjustments.

total_price.description: Updated total price for this line item (quantity * unit_price). Automatically calculated by the system when quantity or unit_price is modified. Must be a non-negative value representing the total cost in the order's currency.

product_name.description: Updated product name as it appeared when ordered. Used for correcting product name errors or updating product information after customer requests. Must match the original product name format and length constraints.

product_attributes.description: Updated JSON string containing product attributes at order time. Used for correcting attribute information or updating product specifications after customer requests. Must maintain valid JSON format and preserve historical attribute accuracy.

IShoppingMallOrderItem.IUpdate.description:
Data required to update an existing order item within a shopping mall order.

This DTO allows modification of order item properties after creation, supporting partial updates for quantity adjustments, pricing corrections, and product information updates. All fields are optional to enable flexible modification scenarios while maintaining data integrity.

When updating quantities or pricing, the system automatically recalculates dependent values to ensure financial accuracy. Product variant and seller references cannot be changed after order item creation, as they represent the historical state of the purchase at the time of order placement.

The update operation validates that the target order and order item exist and are in a modifiable state, ensuring that only appropriate modifications can be applied to maintain audit integrity and preserve the original purchase context.

id.description: Unique identifier for the order item record. Generated automatically when the order item is created and remains immutable throughout the order lifecycle.

quantity.description: Quantity of the product variant ordered. Must be a positive integer greater than zero. Represents the exact quantity purchased by the customer at the time of order.

unit_price.description: Price per unit at the time of order. Represents the historical pricing snapshot captured when the order was placed, ensuring price consistency for historical records.

total_price.description: Total price for this line item (quantity * unit_price). Automatically calculated and maintained as a snapshot of the financial commitment at order time.

product_name.description: Product name as it appeared when ordered. Preserves the exact product information displayed to the customer during the purchase process.

product_attributes.description: JSON string containing product attributes at order time. Captures the complete product specification state as it existed during the purchase, including size, color, configuration options, and other variant-specific details.

created_at.description: Item creation timestamp. Records the exact moment when the order item was added to the shopping cart or order.

updated_at.description: Last item update timestamp. Tracks the most recent modification to the order item, including quantity adjustments or price updates.

order.description: Parent order containing this item. Provides essential context for order identification and relationship mapping without requiring full order details.

product_variant.description: Specific product variant ordered. References the exact product configuration selected by the customer at purchase time.

seller.description: Seller who provided the product. Identifies the business entity responsible for product fulfillment and customer service.

IShoppingMallOrderItem.ISummary.description:
Summary view of individual order items with essential product and pricing information.

Contains the core details needed to display order line items in summary views, including product name, quantity, pricing information, and essential context references. This summary provides complete information for list displays while maintaining optimal performance by excluding large text fields and complex nested objects.
