min_shipping_cost.description:
Minimum shipping cost filter for financial analysis and cost-based result filtering.

Returns shipments with shipping costs equal to or greater than the specified value. Enables identification of high-value shipments, cost trend analysis, and budgetary monitoring.

Useful for financial reporting, carrier cost comparison, and operational efficiency analysis. Combined with maximum cost filtering, creates precise cost ranges for targeted financial review.

max_shipping_cost.description:
Maximum shipping cost filter for financial control and cost ceiling enforcement.

Returns shipments with shipping costs equal to or less than the specified value. Supports cost containment monitoring, budget adherence verification, and identification of cost outliers.

Essential for financial management, exception reporting, and operational cost optimization. When used with minimum cost filtering, defines specific cost ranges for detailed financial analysis.

min_estimated_delivery.description:
Minimum estimated delivery date filter for timeline-based shipment searching.

Returns shipments with estimated delivery dates on or after the specified timestamp. Enables future delivery planning, capacity forecasting, and delivery timeline analysis.

Useful for operational planning, customer service anticipation, and delivery workload forecasting. Helps identify upcoming deliveries requiring preparation or special handling considerations.

max_estimated_delivery.description:
Maximum estimated delivery date filter for delivery timeline management.

Returns shipments with estimated delivery dates on or before the specified timestamp. Supports delivery performance monitoring, timeline compliance verification, and past delivery analysis.

Essential for service level agreement tracking, delivery performance reporting, and historical trend analysis. Combined with minimum date filtering, creates precise delivery windows for targeted review.

oneOf.description: Sort shipment results by creation timestamp for chronological analysis.
Sort shipment results by estimated delivery date for timeline planning.
Sort shipment results by shipping cost for financial analysis.

order_by.description:
Primary field for sorting shipment search results, determining result ordering.

Available sorting options support different analytical perspectives: created_at for chronological review, estimated_delivery for delivery planning, and shipping_cost for financial analysis.

Sorting enhances result usability by organizing records based on relevant business criteria. Combined with direction parameter, enables both ascending and descending order arrangements for comprehensive data review.

oneOf.description: Ascending sort order (oldest first, earliest delivery, lowest cost).
Descending sort order (newest first, latest delivery, highest cost).

direction.description:
Sorting direction controlling the order of returned shipment records.

Ascending order (asc) arranges records from smallest to largest values, suitable for historical analysis and baseline reporting. Descending order (desc) arranges records from largest to smallest values, ideal for recent activity review and priority identification.

The direction parameter works with order_by to provide flexible result organization tailored to specific analytical needs and user preferences.

IShoppingMallShipment.IRequest.description:
Comprehensive search and filtering criteria for shipment retrieval operations with advanced capabilities.

Provides extensive filtering options for searching through shipment records based on carrier information, delivery status, cost ranges, delivery timelines, and tracking details. Supports sophisticated search scenarios including date range filtering, cost analysis, and status-based operational monitoring.

The request type enables flexible search capabilities while maintaining performance through pagination controls and targeted filtering options. Advanced filtering supports both administrative oversight and customer service scenarios with precise result set control.

Combined with pagination parameters, ensures efficient handling of large data sets while providing granular control over result composition. The comprehensive filtering capabilities support diverse use cases from basic shipment lookup to complex operational analysis and reporting requirements.

id.description: Primary key identifier for the shipment record. Automatically generated UUID v4 that uniquely identifies each shipment in the system. Used for database retrieval and API operations requiring shipment identification.

order.description:
Reference to the order being shipped, providing complete context for shipment tracking.

Contains essential order information including order number, total amount, currency, status, and customer details. This reference ensures proper shipment-to-order relationship mapping while maintaining data integrity and preventing orphaned shipment records.

carrier.description:
Shipping carrier responsible for package delivery and tracking services.

Supported carriers include USPS, FedEx, UPS, DHL, and other major logistics providers. Each carrier maintains specific tracking systems and delivery standards that customers can monitor through the provided tracking URLs.

tracking_number.description:
Unique tracking number assigned by the carrier for shipment monitoring.

This identifier enables real-time tracking through carrier APIs and provides customers with delivery progress visibility. Tracking numbers follow carrier-specific formats and are validated against carrier systems during shipment creation.

shipping_method.description:
Shipping service level selected for package delivery.

Available methods include standard ground shipping, expedited delivery, overnight service, and international options. Each method has specific delivery timelines and cost structures that impact the overall shipping experience.

shipping_cost.description:
Cost associated with this specific shipment, calculated based on package weight, dimensions, and selected shipping method.

Represents the actual shipping fee charged to the customer, excluding product costs and taxes. This amount contributes to the order's total shipping calculation and financial reporting.

status.description:
Current status of the shipment lifecycle from creation through final delivery.

Valid status values include: label_created (initial state), picked_up (carrier collected), in_transit (package moving), out_for_delivery (local delivery), delivered (successful completion). Each status transition triggers customer notifications and system updates.

estimated_delivery.description:
Estimated delivery date provided by the carrier based on shipping method and destination.

This projection helps customers anticipate package arrival and plan accordingly. Estimates may be updated by carriers based on actual transit progress and external factors affecting delivery timelines.

actual_delivery.description:
Actual timestamp when the package was successfully delivered to the recipient.

Captured through carrier API integration or manual confirmation. This timestamp marks the completion of the shipment lifecycle and triggers order status updates and customer notifications.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when the shipment record was initially created in the system.

Represents the start of the shipment lifecycle and serves as a reference point for tracking shipment duration and performance metrics.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp of the most recent update to the shipment record.

Tracks all modifications including status changes, tracking updates, and delivery confirmations. Provides audit trail for shipment management and customer service inquiries.

IShoppingMallShipment.ISummary.description:
Summary view of shipment information optimized for efficient tracking and overview displays.

Provides essential shipping details suitable for order summaries, shipment lists, and customer tracking dashboards. This summary format excludes sensitive implementation details while maintaining sufficient context for shipment monitoring and management.

The summary includes key carrier information, tracking details, and delivery timelines that customers need to monitor their package progress. By referencing the order summary rather than exposing raw order IDs, this format maintains data integrity while preventing excessive information exposure.

Used primarily in administrative interfaces, customer order history pages, and shipment tracking systems where full shipment details are not required. The compact design ensures optimal performance in list views and search results while maintaining comprehensive shipment context.

carrier.description:
Shipping carrier selection for package delivery services.

Supported carriers include USPS, FedEx, UPS, DHL, and other major logistics providers. Each carrier offers specific service levels, tracking capabilities, and delivery networks that impact shipping costs and delivery timelines. Carrier selection must be validated against supported options during shipment creation.

tracking_number.description:
Unique tracking number assigned by the selected carrier for shipment monitoring.

This identifier enables real-time tracking integration with carrier APIs and provides customers with delivery progress visibility. Tracking numbers must follow carrier-specific formats and be validated against carrier systems to ensure accurate tracking functionality.

shipping_method.description:
Shipping service level selection determining delivery speed and cost.

Available methods include standard ground shipping (3-7 business days), expedited delivery (2-3 business days), overnight service (next business day), and international options. Method selection impacts carrier availability, shipping costs, and customer delivery expectations.

shipping_cost.description:
Cost calculation for this specific shipment based on package characteristics.

Determined by package weight, dimensions, destination, and selected shipping method. This cost represents the actual shipping fee charged to the customer and contributes to the order's financial calculations and profit margins.

status.description:
Initial shipment status setting upon creation.

Typically defaults to 'label_created' indicating the shipment record has been initialized but not yet processed by the carrier. Administrators may set alternative initial statuses for special handling scenarios or manual status overrides.

estimated_delivery.description:
Projected delivery date based on carrier service levels and destination.

Provides customers with delivery expectations and helps manage customer communications. This estimate may be refined by carriers based on actual transit progress and operational factors affecting delivery schedules.

shipping_label_url.description:
URL for accessing the shipping label document required for package processing.

Points to the generated shipping label that carriers scan during pickup and processing. Label URLs must be accessible to shipping personnel and integrate with carrier label printing systems for efficient package handling.

tracking_url.description:
URL directing customers to the carrier's tracking page for real-time updates.

Provides direct access to carrier tracking systems where customers can monitor package progress, estimated delivery times, and any delivery exceptions or delays encountered during transit.

IShoppingMallShipment.ICreate.description:
Shipment creation data structure for initiating new shipping records in the shopping mall platform.

Contains all necessary information to create a shipment record including carrier selection, tracking setup, shipping method configuration, and cost calculations. This DTO integrates with carrier systems to validate shipping options and generate tracking capabilities.

The creation process excludes system-managed fields like id, created_at, and updated_at, which are automatically generated. The target order is identified through the API path parameter `/shoppingMall/admin/orders/{orderId}/shipments` rather than duplicate order references in the request body.

Optional fields like estimated_delivery, shipping_label_url, and tracking_url provide enhanced shipment functionality when available, while status allows for custom initial state configuration when needed. All field validations ensure shipment records maintain data integrity and carrier compliance standards.

carrier.description:
Shipping carrier responsible for delivery (USPS, FedEx, UPS, DHL, etc.). This field identifies the logistics provider handling the shipment and determines tracking capabilities and delivery timelines.

Carrier selection impacts shipping costs, delivery speed, and tracking availability. Valid carriers are configured in the system and must be selected from approved provider lists to ensure proper integration with carrier APIs for real-time tracking updates.

tracking_number.description:
Unique tracking number assigned by the carrier for shipment tracking and monitoring.

This identifier enables customers and administrators to track shipment progress through carrier systems. Tracking numbers must be unique within the system and follow carrier-specific format requirements. The system validates tracking number uniqueness and format compliance during updates.

shipping_method.description:
Shipping service level selected for the delivery (standard, expedited, overnight).

Defines the speed and priority of the shipment delivery. Standard shipping provides economical delivery with longer transit times, while expedited and overnight options offer faster delivery at premium costs. Shipping method selection affects both delivery timelines and shipping costs.

shipping_cost.description:
Cost associated with this specific shipment in the order's currency.

Represents the actual shipping cost charged by the carrier for this shipment. Must be non-negative and reflects the carrier's pricing for the selected shipping method and package characteristics. Shipping costs are calculated based on package weight, dimensions, and destination.

status.description:
Current status of the shipment tracking its delivery lifecycle (label_created, picked_up, in_transit, out_for_delivery, delivered).

Status transitions follow a predefined workflow: label_created → picked_up → in_transit → out_for_delivery → delivered. Status updates are typically received from carrier APIs and provide real-time visibility into shipment progress. Invalid status transitions are rejected to maintain workflow integrity.

estimated_delivery.description:
Estimated delivery date and time provided by the carrier based on shipping method and destination.

This timestamp represents the carrier's projected delivery timeframe. Estimated delivery dates are calculated using carrier algorithms considering distance, service level, and operational factors. Actual delivery may vary based on weather, traffic, and other external conditions.

actual_delivery.description:
Actual timestamp when the package was successfully delivered to the recipient.

This field is populated automatically when the carrier confirms delivery through their tracking system. Actual delivery timestamps provide precise completion records for order fulfillment tracking and customer service purposes. Once set, this field cannot be modified.

shipping_label_url.description:
URL to download the shipping label document for printing and carrier processing.

Shipping labels contain essential information for carriers including recipient address, package details, and barcodes for scanning. Label URLs are generated by the shipping system and provide secure access to printable label documents. Labels expire after a configured period for security.

tracking_url.description:
Direct URL to the carrier's tracking page for real-time shipment monitoring.

This link provides customers with direct access to carrier tracking systems for detailed shipment progress information. Tracking URLs are dynamically generated based on carrier and tracking number to ensure accurate redirection to the appropriate carrier tracking interface.

IShoppingMallShipment.IUpdate.description:
Updated shipment information including carrier details, tracking, and delivery status for order fulfillment management.

This DTO allows authorized administrators to modify shipment properties while maintaining data integrity and workflow compliance. All fields are optional to support partial updates, enabling granular modifications without requiring complete object replacement.

The DTO excludes immutable fields such as shipment ID, creation timestamps, and order references to prevent unauthorized modifications. Status transitions are validated server-side to ensure they follow proper workflow sequences (e.g., cannot revert from delivered status).

Security enforcement ensures that only authorized administrators with appropriate permissions can update shipments, with additional validation to confirm users have access to the associated order. The system automatically tracks update timestamps and maintains audit trails for compliance purposes.

id.description:
Primary key identifier for the coupon record, automatically generated using UUID v4.

This unique identifier provides the primary reference for coupon operations and relationships. The ID is immutable and serves as the internal system reference for coupon management, tracking, and audit purposes.

code.description:
Unique uppercase alphanumeric coupon code that customers enter during checkout for discount application.

Coupon codes must be unique across the platform and follow strict formatting requirements: uppercase letters and numbers only, no special characters. Codes are designed for easy customer entry while maintaining uniqueness constraints for proper coupon identification.

name.description:
Descriptive name for the coupon used for administrative identification and reporting.

Provides human-readable identification for coupon management interfaces. Names should clearly indicate the coupon's purpose, target audience, or promotion type to facilitate easy administration and reporting.

description.description:
Detailed description explaining coupon terms, conditions, eligibility criteria, and usage restrictions.

This comprehensive description provides both administrators and customers with clear understanding of coupon applicability, limitations, and business rules. Descriptions should cover all relevant terms to prevent misuse and ensure proper coupon application.

discount_type.description:
Type of discount offered by the coupon: percentage, fixed_amount, or free_shipping.

Percentage discounts reduce order totals by a specified percentage, fixed_amount discounts subtract a specific monetary amount, and free_shipping discounts waive shipping costs. Discount type determines how the coupon value is applied during checkout calculations.

discount_value.description:
Discount amount or percentage value applied when the coupon is used.

For percentage discounts, this value represents the percentage reduction (e.g., 10 for 10% off). For fixed_amount discounts, this is the monetary reduction amount. Must be positive and validated against order totals to ensure meaningful discount application.

minimum_order_amount.description:
Minimum order amount required to use this coupon, ensuring discounts apply only to qualifying purchases.

This threshold prevents coupon misuse on small-value orders. When specified, the coupon can only be applied to orders meeting or exceeding this amount. Optional field that provides additional control over coupon applicability.

maximum_discount.description:
Maximum discount amount cap for percentage-based coupons to prevent excessive discounts.

For percentage discounts, this field limits the maximum monetary value of the discount regardless of order size. This protects against revenue loss on high-value orders while still providing meaningful savings on typical purchases.

usage_limit_per_customer.description:
Maximum number of times a single customer can use this coupon, preventing abuse and ensuring fair distribution.

This limit controls coupon usage at the customer level to prevent individuals from exploiting unlimited coupon benefits. When reached, the customer cannot apply the coupon to additional orders.

total_usage_limit.description:
Overall maximum usage limit for this coupon across all customers, controlling total platform exposure.

This global limit ensures the coupon's financial impact remains within budgeted parameters. Once the total usage count reaches this limit, the coupon becomes inactive and cannot be applied to new orders.

used_count.description:
Current usage count tracking how many times this coupon has been successfully applied to orders.

This counter provides real-time visibility into coupon utilization for reporting and limit enforcement. The system automatically increments this value each time the coupon is successfully applied during checkout.

valid_from.description:
Date and time when the coupon becomes active and available for use.

Coupons cannot be applied before this timestamp. This allows administrators to schedule coupon availability in advance for promotional campaigns and ensures coupons are only active during intended timeframes.

valid_until.description:
Date and time when the coupon expires and becomes inactive.

After this timestamp, the coupon cannot be applied to new orders regardless of other conditions. Expiration ensures coupons have finite lifetimes and prevents indefinite coupon availability.

is_active.description:
Indicates whether the coupon is currently active and available for customer use.

This flag provides manual control over coupon availability independent of validity periods. Administrators can temporarily deactivate coupons without deleting them, allowing for quick response to issues or campaign adjustments.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when the coupon record was created in the system.

Provides audit trail information for coupon lifecycle tracking. This timestamp is automatically set during coupon creation and remains immutable throughout the coupon's existence.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp of the most recent update to the coupon configuration or properties.

Tracks modification history for audit purposes. This field is automatically updated whenever coupon properties are modified, providing visibility into configuration changes over time.

deleted_at.description:
Timestamp when the coupon was soft deleted for data retention and archival purposes.

Supports soft deletion functionality, allowing coupon removal without permanent data loss. Deleted coupons are excluded from active operations but remain accessible for reporting and audit requirements.

shopping_mall_channel_id.description:
Foreign key reference to the channel where this coupon is valid and applicable.

When specified, restricts coupon usage to orders placed through the designated channel. Provides channel-specific coupon targeting for segmented marketing campaigns and channel-specific promotions.

shopping_mall_administrator_id.description:
Foreign key reference to the administrator who created this coupon.

Maintains creator attribution for audit and responsibility tracking. This relationship ensures proper accountability for coupon creation and configuration.

shopping_mall_administrator_session_id.description:
Foreign key reference to the administrator session when this coupon was created.

Provides detailed audit trail information including the specific session context during coupon creation. This enhances security auditing and supports detailed investigation capabilities.

channel.description:
Channel entity where this coupon is valid and can be applied to orders.

Provides complete channel context including channel name, description, and configuration. This relationship enables channel-specific coupon targeting and ensures coupons are only applicable to appropriate shopping contexts.

creator.description:
Administrator entity who created and configured this coupon.

Provides complete creator information including administrator name, contact details, and role. This relationship supports proper attribution and accountability for coupon management operations.

IShoppingMallCoupon.description:
Platform-managed discount coupons for customer purchases with comprehensive configuration and tracking capabilities.

Coupons represent promotional discount mechanisms that customers can apply during checkout to reduce order totals. Each coupon supports various discount types including percentage-based reductions, fixed amount deductions, and free shipping offers. Coupons are configured with eligibility criteria, validity periods, and usage limits to control their application and financial impact.

The system enforces coupon rules during checkout validation, ensuring discounts are applied only to qualifying orders that meet minimum amount requirements and other conditions. Coupon usage is tracked at both individual customer and platform levels to prevent abuse and maintain promotional budget control.

Administrators manage coupons through comprehensive configuration interfaces, setting discount parameters, eligibility rules, and activation schedules. Coupons can be targeted to specific customer segments, product categories, or shopping channels for precise promotional targeting. The system maintains complete audit trails including creator information, modification history, and usage statistics for reporting and compliance purposes.

page.description: Page number for pagination (starting from 1). Used to navigate through large result sets with configurable page sizes.

limit.description: Number of items per page (maximum 100). Controls the size of each pagination batch for optimal performance.

search.description: Search query to filter coupons by code or name. Supports partial matching and case-insensitive text search.

discount_type.description: Filter by specific discount type: percentage, fixed_amount, free_shipping. Allows filtering coupons by their discount mechanism.

is_active.description: Filter by active status. Shows only currently active coupons or includes inactive ones based on boolean value.

valid_from_min.description: Minimum valid from date filter. Finds coupons that become active on or after this date.

valid_from_max.description: Maximum valid from date filter. Finds coupons that become active on or before this date.

valid_until_min.description: Minimum valid until date filter. Finds coupons that expire on or after this date.

valid_until_max.description: Maximum valid until date filter. Finds coupons that expire on or before this date.

channel_id.description: Filter by specific shopping mall channel ID. Restricts results to coupons valid only in the specified channel.

creator_id.description: Filter by administrator who created the coupon. Useful for audit trails and administrative reporting.

usage_limit_per_customer.description: Filter by customer-specific usage limit. Finds coupons with specific per-customer usage restrictions.

total_usage_limit.description: Filter by overall usage limit. Identifies coupons with specific total usage caps across all customers.

used_count_min.description: Minimum usage count filter. Finds coupons that have been used at least this many times.

used_count_max.description: Maximum usage count filter. Finds coupons that have been used at most this many times.

oneOf.description: Sort results by coupon creation timestamp for chronological ordering.
Sort results by coupon activation date for validity period ordering.
Sort results by coupon expiration date for expiration timeline ordering.
Sort results by discount amount for value-based ordering.
Sort results by usage count for popularity-based ordering.

order_by.description: Field to sort results by. Determines the primary ordering criteria for search results.

oneOf.description: Sort direction: ascending order from smallest to largest values.
Sort direction: descending order from largest to smallest values.

order_direction.description: Sort direction: ascending or descending. Controls the ordering sequence of search results.

IShoppingMallCoupon.IRequest.description:
Search criteria and pagination parameters for coupon filtering.

Provides comprehensive filtering options for searching coupons including discount type, validity period, active status, usage statistics, and administrative context. Supports pagination with configurable page sizes and sorting by various coupon properties.

The search functionality allows filtering by coupon code or name using text search with partial matching capabilities. Date range filters enable finding coupons valid within specific time periods, while usage statistics filters help identify popular or underutilized coupons.

Administrative filtering options include channel-specific restrictions and creator-based filtering for audit purposes. The operation supports complex filtering logic with multiple conditions combined using AND/OR operators for precise result targeting.

code.description: Unique coupon code that customers enter during checkout. Must be uppercase and alphanumeric. Generated automatically by the system to ensure uniqueness across the platform.

name.description: Descriptive name for the coupon for administrative purposes. Helps administrators identify and manage coupons effectively.

description.description: Detailed description explaining coupon terms and conditions. Provides customers with clear information about coupon eligibility and usage rules.

discount_type.description: Type of discount: percentage, fixed_amount, free_shipping. Determines how the discount is calculated when applied to orders.

discount_value.description: Discount amount or percentage value. Must be positive. For percentage discounts, represents the percentage reduction; for fixed amounts, represents the dollar value reduction.

minimum_order_amount.description: Minimum order amount required to use this coupon. Ensures coupons are only applied to qualifying orders that meet the minimum threshold.

maximum_discount.description: Maximum discount amount for percentage-based coupons. Prevents excessive discounts on high-value orders while maintaining percentage-based calculations.

usage_limit_per_customer.description: Maximum times a single customer can use this coupon. Controls coupon usage per customer to prevent abuse and ensure fair distribution.

total_usage_limit.description: Overall maximum usage limit for this coupon. Sets a cap on total redemptions across all customers to manage promotional budgets.

valid_from.description: Date and time when coupon becomes active. Coupons cannot be used before this timestamp.

valid_until.description: Date and time when coupon expires. Coupons cannot be used after this timestamp.

is_active.description: Whether the coupon is currently active for use. Inactive coupons are visible but cannot be applied to orders.

shopping_mall_channel_id.description: Channel where this coupon is valid. References the specific shopping mall channel that can use this coupon.

IShoppingMallCoupon.ICreate.description:
Coupon creation parameters including discount configuration, validity period, and usage limits.

This DTO is used when creating new coupons in the shopping mall platform with comprehensive configuration options for discount behavior, eligibility criteria, and promotional controls. The system supports various discount types including percentage-based discounts, fixed amount reductions, and free shipping offers.

Security considerations ensure that administrative context (creator information) is automatically populated from authentication context rather than being accepted from request bodies, maintaining proper audit trails. The coupon code must be unique across the platform and follows uppercase alphanumeric format requirements.

Business logic includes validation of minimum order amounts, maximum discount caps for percentage-based coupons, and proper configuration of customer-specific and overall usage limits. The operation sets default values for tracking fields and ensures proper timestamp recording for audit purposes.

name.description:
Descriptive name for the coupon used for administrative identification and reporting.

This field allows administrators to update the coupon's display name for better management and tracking.
The name should clearly identify the coupon's purpose and target audience for easy reference.

description.description:
Detailed explanation of coupon terms, conditions, and promotional context.

Provides comprehensive information about coupon eligibility rules, redemption conditions, and any special terms.
This description is displayed to administrators and may be shown to customers during coupon application.

discount_type.description:
Type of discount mechanism applied by this coupon.

Valid values include: percentage (percentage-based discount), fixed_amount (fixed monetary discount), 
and free_shipping (waived shipping costs). Each discount type has specific validation requirements
and calculation methods that must be consistent with the discount_value field.

discount_value.description:
Numerical value representing the discount amount or percentage.

For percentage discounts, this value represents the percentage rate (e.g., 10 for 10% discount).
For fixed amount discounts, this value represents the monetary discount in the platform's base currency.
Must be a positive value greater than zero to ensure valid discount application.

minimum_order_amount.description:
Minimum order subtotal required for coupon eligibility.

Specifies the threshold order amount that must be met before the coupon can be applied.
This field helps target coupons to specific customer spending levels and prevents coupon
abuse on very small orders. If null, no minimum order amount restriction applies.

maximum_discount.description:
Maximum discount cap for percentage-based coupons.

Limits the total discount amount when using percentage-based discounts to prevent excessive
coupon value on high-priced items. Only applicable when discount_type is 'percentage'.
If null, no maximum discount cap is enforced for percentage-based coupons.

usage_limit_per_customer.description:
Maximum number of times a single customer can use this coupon.

Helps prevent coupon abuse by limiting individual customer usage while still allowing
broader distribution. If null, customers can use the coupon unlimited times within
the validity period, subject to overall usage limits.

total_usage_limit.description:
Overall maximum usage limit for this coupon across all customers.

Controls the total number of times this coupon can be redeemed system-wide.
This limit helps manage promotional budgets and ensures coupon availability
is controlled according to marketing strategy. If null, no overall usage limit applies.

valid_from.description:
Start date and time when the coupon becomes active and redeemable.

Coupons cannot be applied to orders placed before this timestamp.
The system validates that valid_from is before valid_until and that
both dates are in the future when creating new coupons.

valid_until.description:
Expiration date and time when the coupon becomes inactive.

Coupons cannot be applied to orders placed after this timestamp.
The system automatically deactivates coupons that have passed their
valid_until date, regardless of their is_active status.

is_active.description:
Activation status controlling whether the coupon can be used.

When false, the coupon cannot be applied to any orders even if within
the validity period. This allows administrators to temporarily disable
coupons without deleting them or modifying their configuration.

channel.description:
Shopping channel where this coupon is valid and applicable.

Coupons can be restricted to specific shopping channels to target
particular market segments or geographic regions. If null, the coupon
is valid across all shopping channels in the platform.

IShoppingMallCoupon.IUpdate.description:
Coupon update data transfer object for modifying existing coupon configurations.

This DTO supports partial updates to coupon properties, allowing administrators to modify specific aspects of coupon configuration without requiring complete object replacement. All fields are optional to enable granular updates that maintain data integrity while minimizing the risk of unintended changes.

The update operation validates that modifications don't conflict with existing coupon usage or violate business rules. For example, changing discount values or validity periods is validated against orders that have already used the coupon to ensure consistency. The system also prevents modifications that would invalidate active coupon applications.

Security enforcement ensures that only authorized administrators with appropriate permissions can modify coupons. The system automatically tracks update timestamps for audit purposes and maintains a complete history of coupon configuration changes for compliance and troubleshooting.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the coupon record in the system.

Generated automatically when the coupon is created and remains constant
throughout the coupon's lifecycle. Used for internal reference and
database relationships rather than customer-facing identification.

code.description:
Customer-facing coupon code used for redemption during checkout.

Must be unique across all coupons and typically follows uppercase alphanumeric
format for easy customer entry. This code is what customers enter to apply
the coupon to their orders and is the primary customer-facing identifier.

name.description:
Descriptive name identifying the coupon's purpose and target audience.

Used by administrators for coupon management, reporting, and identification.
The name should clearly communicate the coupon's promotional intent and
help distinguish it from other coupons in the system.

discount_type.description:
Type of discount mechanism applied by this coupon.

Indicates whether the coupon provides percentage-based discounts, fixed
amount reductions, or free shipping benefits. This determines how the
discount_value is interpreted and applied during order calculations.

discount_value.description:
Numerical value representing the discount amount or percentage rate.

The interpretation depends on the discount_type: for percentage discounts,
this is the percentage rate; for fixed_amount discounts, this is the monetary
reduction; for free_shipping, this field may indicate shipping cost coverage.

minimum_order_amount.description:
Minimum order subtotal required for coupon eligibility.

Helps target coupons to specific customer spending levels and prevents
coupon abuse on very small orders. If not specified, the coupon can be
applied to orders of any amount within the validity period.

valid_from.description:
Start date and time when the coupon becomes active and redeemable.

Coupons cannot be applied to orders placed before this timestamp.
Used in conjunction with valid_until to define the coupon's active period.

valid_until.description:
Expiration date and time when the coupon becomes inactive.

Coupons cannot be applied to orders placed after this timestamp.
The system automatically respects this expiration regardless of other
coupon settings or activation status.

is_active.description:
Current activation status controlling coupon usability.

Indicates whether the coupon can currently be applied to orders,
considering both the manual activation status and validity period.
Coupons must be both active and within their validity period to be usable.

used_count.description:
Current number of times this coupon has been successfully applied.

Tracks coupon usage for reporting and limit enforcement. This count
helps administrators monitor coupon performance and ensures usage
limits are properly enforced across the platform.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when the coupon was originally created in the system.

Provides historical tracking of when the coupon was first configured
and helps with coupon lifecycle management and reporting.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp when the coupon configuration was last modified.

Helps track recent changes to coupon settings and supports audit
trail requirements for coupon management operations.

IShoppingMallCoupon.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of shopping mall coupon entities for list views and quick reference.

This DTO provides essential coupon information optimized for performance in list displays, search results, and summary contexts where full coupon details are not required. It includes core identification fields, discount configuration, validity period, usage statistics, and activation status.

The summary view excludes detailed descriptions, complex relationships, and administrative metadata to maintain lightweight performance characteristics. It's suitable for coupon selection interfaces, promotional displays, and administrative dashboards where multiple coupons need to be displayed simultaneously.

Usage tracking fields (used_count) provide immediate visibility into coupon performance, while timestamps (created_at, updated_at) support basic chronological sorting and filtering operations. The design prioritizes readability and quick scanning while maintaining sufficient detail for most coupon management scenarios.

id.description: Unique identifier for the promotion campaign. Generated automatically using UUID v4 format upon creation. Used for all promotion-related operations and tracking.

name.description: Promotion name for identification and display purposes. Must be unique across all promotions in the system. Used for human-readable identification and API operations referencing specific promotions.

description.description: Detailed description of promotion terms, benefits, and conditions for customer reference. Explains the promotion's value proposition, eligibility criteria, and redemption instructions. Supports rich text formatting for comprehensive marketing communication.

promotion_type.description: Type of promotion campaign: sale, clearance, loyalty, seasonal, etc. Defines the category and behavior of the promotion for proper system evaluation and customer targeting. Common types include percentage discounts, fixed amount discounts, buy-one-get-one, and loyalty rewards.

start_date.description: Date and time when the promotion becomes active and available to customers. Must be before the end_date. The system automatically activates promotions when this timestamp is reached. Supports ISO 8601 format for precise scheduling.

end_date.description: Date and time when the promotion expires and is no longer available to customers. Must be after the start_date. The system automatically deactivates promotions when this timestamp is reached. Supports ISO 8601 format for precise expiration management.

is_active.description: Indicates whether the promotion is currently active and being applied to customer transactions. Can be manually toggled by administrators for campaign management. System also automatically manages this based on date ranges and activation rules.

priority.description: Priority level for promotion ordering and conflict resolution. Higher numbers indicate higher priority. Used when multiple promotions could apply to the same transaction - higher priority promotions take precedence. Range typically 1-100.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the promotion was originally created by an administrator. Automatically set by the system and cannot be modified. Used for audit tracking and campaign lifecycle management.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the promotion was last modified by an administrator. Automatically updated by the system on every change. Used for tracking recent updates and synchronization purposes.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the promotion was soft deleted from the system. Allows for recovery and historical tracking while removing the promotion from active operations. Null indicates the promotion is still active.

channel.description: Shopping channel where this promotion is active and applicable. Optional association allowing promotions to be channel-specific or platform-wide. When specified, the promotion only applies to transactions within the designated channel.

creator.description: Administrator who created and manages this promotion campaign. Provides audit trail and ownership information for campaign management and support purposes.

IShoppingMallPromotion.description:
Marketing promotion campaigns in the shopping mall platform.

Represents promotional campaigns that include various marketing incentives such as discounts, special pricing, coupons, and loyalty rewards. Each promotion has specific scheduling constraints, target audiences, and eligibility criteria defined through promotion rules. Promotions are essential for driving customer engagement, increasing sales, and rewarding loyalty across the shopping mall ecosystem.

Promotions are managed by platform administrators and can be associated with specific shopping channels, products, or customer segments. The system evaluates promotions during customer checkout processes to determine applicable discounts and incentives based on complex rule evaluation and priority resolution.

This entity tracks promotion lifecycle from creation through activation, application, and expiration. Soft deletion support preserves historical promotion data for reporting and analysis purposes while maintaining data integrity. Promotion performance metrics and customer engagement data are tracked separately for campaign optimization.

name.description: Unique name identifier for the new promotion campaign. Must be unique across all promotions in the system. Used for API operations and human-readable identification. Should be descriptive and meaningful for campaign management.

description.description: Detailed description of promotion terms and benefits for customers. Should clearly explain the promotion's value proposition, eligibility requirements, and redemption process. Supports rich text formatting for comprehensive marketing communication.

promotion_type.description: Type of promotion: sale, clearance, loyalty, seasonal, etc. Defines the category and behavior of the promotion. Common types include percentage discounts, fixed amount discounts, buy-one-get-one offers, and loyalty reward programs.

start_date.description: Date and time when the promotion should become active. Must be in the future relative to creation time. Supports ISO 8601 format for precise scheduling. The system validates that start_date is before end_date.

end_date.description: Date and time when the promotion should expire. Must be after the start_date. Supports ISO 8601 format for precise expiration management. The system validates logical date ranges and prevents overlapping active periods.

is_active.description: Whether the promotion should be active immediately after creation. If false, the promotion will remain inactive until manually activated or until the start_date is reached. Allows for campaign pre-configuration and scheduled activation.

priority.description: Priority level for promotion ordering (higher numbers = higher priority). Used when multiple promotions could apply to the same transaction. Range typically 1-100, with higher numbers taking precedence in conflict resolution.

channel_id.description: Optional channel identifier where promotion should be active. If provided, the promotion will only apply to transactions within the specified channel. If omitted, the promotion applies platform-wide to all channels.

IShoppingMallPromotion.ICreate.description:
Creation data for marketing promotion campaigns.

Defines the initial configuration for new promotional campaigns including scheduling, targeting, and incentive structures. The system validates that promotion names are unique and that scheduling constraints are logical (start date before end date).

Channel association is optional - promotions can be platform-wide or channel-specific. Priority levels determine how promotions are evaluated when multiple promotions could apply to the same transaction. Higher priority promotions take precedence in conflict resolution scenarios.

Administrator identity is automatically captured from the authentication context and does not need to be provided in the creation request. Promotion rules can be added separately after creation to define specific eligibility criteria, discount structures, and targeting parameters.

Security Note: Administrator identity fields (shopping_mall_administrator_id, shopping_mall_administrator_session_id) are intentionally excluded as they come from verified JWT authentication tokens, not client request bodies. This ensures proper security and prevents unauthorized promotion creation.

name.description:
Updated promotion name for identification and display purposes. Must remain unique across all promotions if changed during update. The system validates uniqueness against existing promotion names to prevent conflicts.

Promotion names should clearly identify the campaign purpose and target audience. Name changes require revalidation of uniqueness constraints while maintaining promotion continuity.

description.description:
Updated detailed description of promotion terms, benefits, and conditions. Provides comprehensive information about the promotion's scope, eligibility criteria, and customer benefits.

Descriptions should clearly communicate promotion rules, limitations, and value propositions to both customers and administrators. Large text fields may be truncated in summary views but preserved in full detail records.

promotion_type.description:
Updated classification of the promotion campaign type. Common types include: seasonal sales, clearance events, loyalty rewards, new customer incentives, and product-specific promotions.

Promotion types determine how the system evaluates eligibility and applies discounts during customer checkout processes. Type changes may require validation of associated promotion rules.

start_date.description:
Updated activation date and time when the promotion becomes available to customers. Must be a valid future or current date-time in ISO 8601 format.

The system validates that start dates remain logical relative to end dates and that scheduling changes don't create conflicts with existing customer transactions.

end_date.description:
Updated expiration date and time when the promotion becomes unavailable. Must be a valid future date-time in ISO 8601 format that occurs after the start date.

End date modifications ensure promotions expire appropriately while maintaining consistency with customer expectations and business scheduling requirements.

is_active.description:
Updated active status indicating whether the promotion is currently being applied to customer transactions. Active promotions are evaluated during checkout, while inactive promotions are ignored.

Status changes allow administrators to temporarily disable promotions without deleting them, preserving campaign history and reactivation capabilities.

priority.description:
Updated priority level for promotion evaluation ordering and conflict resolution. Higher numbers indicate higher priority when multiple promotions apply to the same transaction.

Priority values range from 1 (lowest) to 100 (highest). The system evaluates promotions in priority order, applying the highest priority eligible promotion first during checkout processes.

shopping_mall_channel_id.description:
Updated channel identifier where the promotion is active. References the specific shopping channel ({@link shopping_mall_channels.id}) that this promotion targets.

Channel assignments determine promotion visibility and applicability. Promotions can be channel-specific or platform-wide based on this relationship.

IShoppingMallPromotion.IUpdate.description:
Update data transfer object for modifying existing marketing promotion campaigns in the shopping mall platform.

This DTO allows platform administrators to selectively update promotion properties while maintaining data integrity and business rule compliance. All fields are optional, enabling partial updates without requiring complete promotion re-specification.

The system validates update requests to ensure promotion name uniqueness (if changed), logical scheduling constraints, and consistency with associated promotion rules. Administrator identity and channel context are managed through authentication and endpoint parameters rather than request body fields.

Promotion updates support flexible campaign management, allowing administrators to modify activation schedules, adjust priority levels, update descriptions, and toggle active status without disrupting customer experience or transaction history. The system preserves historical promotion data while applying updates to future customer interactions.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the promotion campaign. Generated automatically using UUID v4 format upon promotion creation.

This primary key ensures each promotion has a globally unique identifier for reference, tracking, and relationship management throughout the shopping mall platform.

name.description:
Promotion name for identification and display purposes. Must be unique across all promotions to prevent conflicts and ensure clear campaign identification.

Promotion names should be descriptive yet concise, clearly communicating the campaign's purpose and target audience to both administrators and customers.

description.description:
Brief description summarizing the promotion's terms, benefits, and conditions. Provides essential context for quick reference in list views and campaign overviews.

While the full description may contain extensive details, this summary field captures the core value proposition and key eligibility criteria for efficient display.

promotion_type.description:
Classification of the promotion campaign type. Common types include seasonal sales, clearance events, loyalty rewards, new customer incentives, and product-specific promotions.

Promotion types determine how the system evaluates eligibility and applies discounts, helping administrators categorize and manage campaigns effectively.

start_date.description:
Date and time when the promotion becomes active and available to customers. Specified in ISO 8601 format for consistent timezone handling and international compatibility.

Start dates determine when promotions begin influencing customer transactions and when they appear in active promotion lists.

end_date.description:
Date and time when the promotion expires and is no longer available. Specified in ISO 8601 format, must occur after the start date to maintain logical scheduling.

End dates control promotion availability and ensure campaigns conclude appropriately, preventing unintended extended availability.

is_active.description:
Indicates whether the promotion is currently active and being applied to customer transactions. Active promotions are evaluated during checkout, while inactive promotions are ignored.

The active status allows administrators to control promotion availability without deleting campaign records, preserving historical data and reactivation capabilities.

priority.description:
Priority level for promotion evaluation ordering and conflict resolution. Higher numbers indicate higher priority when multiple promotions apply to the same transaction.

Priority values range from 1 (lowest) to 100 (highest), enabling administrators to control which promotions take precedence during customer checkout processes.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when the promotion was originally created. Provides historical context for campaign lifecycle tracking and administrative reporting.

Creation timestamps help administrators understand promotion duration, campaign scheduling patterns, and management workflow efficiency.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp when the promotion was last modified. Tracks the most recent update activity for audit trails and change management purposes.

Update timestamps help administrators identify recently modified promotions and understand campaign evolution over time.

IShoppingMallPromotion.ISummary.description:
Summary view of shopping mall promotion campaigns optimized for list displays and quick reference contexts.

This DTO provides essential promotion information for efficient campaign management interfaces, marketing dashboards, and administrative overviews. It includes core identification fields, promotion type classification, active period details, status indicators, and priority levels while excluding extensive descriptive content and complex relationship data.

The summary format balances information density with performance requirements, making it suitable for paginated lists, search results, and campaign selection interfaces where full promotion details are not immediately required. Promotion rules and associated data are managed through separate detailed operations.

Optimized for performance in promotional campaign management systems, this summary view enables administrators to quickly scan active promotions, identify scheduling conflicts, monitor campaign status, and prioritize management activities without loading complete promotion records.

page.description:
Page number for paginated promotion search results.

Specifies which page of promotion records to retrieve in paginated responses.
First page is typically page 1 (not page 0) to maintain user-friendly numbering.
Used in combination with limit parameter to implement efficient pagination for large promotion datasets.

Administrators can navigate through promotion lists efficiently by incrementing page numbers.
The system validates that requested page numbers exist within the total page count.

limit.description:
Number of promotion records per page in paginated results.

Specifies how many promotion records to return per page for efficient data retrieval.
Common values are 10, 25, 50, or 100 records per page based on administrator preferences.
Helps manage performance with large promotion datasets by controlling result set size.

Smaller limits improve response times while larger limits reduce pagination overhead.
The system enforces maximum limit constraints to prevent performance degradation.

search.description:
Search term for filtering promotions by name or description content.

Supports comprehensive text search across promotion names and detailed descriptions.
Returns promotions that contain the search term in either field using case-insensitive matching.
Useful for finding specific promotions by partial name matching or keyword searching.

Supports wildcard patterns and phrase matching for advanced search capabilities.
Empty search terms return all promotions without text filtering applied.

promotion_type.description:
Filter promotions by specific marketing campaign type.

Restricts results to promotions of a particular category or marketing strategy.
Common values include: sale (discount promotions), clearance (inventory reduction),
loyalty (reward programs), seasonal (holiday campaigns), new_customer (acquisition offers).
Allows administrators to focus on specific promotion categories for targeted management.

When not specified, returns promotions of all types regardless of category.
Valid promotion types are enforced based on system configuration.

is_active.description:
Filter by promotion active status for campaign management.

When true, returns only currently active promotions that are within their validity period.
When false, returns only inactive, expired, or suspended promotions for historical review.
When not specified, returns promotions regardless of active status for comprehensive viewing.

Active status considers both the promotion configuration and current date/time.
Administrators can quickly identify campaigns needing attention or extension.

start_date_from.description:
Filter promotions starting after specified date for campaign planning.

Returns promotions with start_date on or after the specified datetime.
Useful for finding promotions that become active in the future for scheduling purposes.
Can be combined with start_date_to parameter for precise date range filtering.

Supports ISO 8601 datetime format for consistent date/time representation.
Future-dated promotions help administrators plan upcoming marketing initiatives.

start_date_to.description:
Filter promotions starting before specified date for historical analysis.

Returns promotions with start_date on or before the specified datetime.
Useful for finding promotions that started in the past for performance evaluation.
Can be combined with start_date_from parameter for comprehensive date range filtering.

Historical promotions provide insights into past campaign effectiveness and patterns.
Supports analysis of seasonal trends and promotional strategy evolution.

end_date_from.description:
Filter promotions ending after specified date for expiration management.

Returns promotions with end_date on or after the specified datetime.
Useful for finding promotions that expire in the future for renewal planning.
Can be combined with end_date_to parameter for expiration date range filtering.

Helps administrators identify promotions needing extension or replacement.
Supports proactive campaign management and continuity planning.

end_date_to.description:
Filter promotions ending before specified date for archival purposes.

Returns promotions with end_date on or before the specified datetime.
Useful for finding promotions that have already expired for historical archiving.
Can be combined with end_date_from parameter for complete expiration range filtering.

Expired promotions can be reviewed for performance analysis and strategy refinement.
Supports compliance with data retention policies and audit requirements.

priority_min.description:
Minimum priority level filter for promotion importance ranking.

Returns promotions with priority greater than or equal to this value.
Useful for focusing on high-priority promotions that require special attention.
Standard priority range is 1-10, with 10 being highest priority for urgent campaigns.

Higher priority promotions typically receive preferential display and resource allocation.
Administrators can quickly identify critical campaigns needing immediate management.

priority_max.description:
Maximum priority level filter for promotion categorization.

Returns promotions with priority less than or equal to this value.
Useful for focusing on lower-priority promotions for routine management.
Standard priority range is 1-10, with 1 being lowest priority for standard campaigns.

Lower priority promotions may have automated management or standard procedures.
Helps administrators allocate resources based on campaign importance levels.

channel_code.description:
Filter promotions by specific shopping channel association.

Restricts results to promotions associated with a particular sales channel.
When specified, returns only promotions targeting the given channel code.
When null or not specified, returns promotions from all channels for platform-wide view.

Channel-specific promotions allow targeted marketing for different customer segments.
Supports multi-channel retail strategies with customized promotional approaches.

oneOf.description:
Sort promotion results alphabetically by promotion name.

Orders promotions in ascending or descending alphabetical order by their name field.
Useful for alphabetical browsing and name-based organization of marketing campaigns.
Provides consistent ordering when administrators need to locate promotions by name.

Sort promotion results by marketing campaign type category.

Groups promotions by their type (sale, clearance, loyalty, etc.) for categorical organization.
Useful for analyzing promotions by marketing strategy and campaign categorization.
Helps administrators compare similar promotion types and identify patterns.

Sort promotion results by campaign activation date.

Orders promotions by their start_date field to see chronological campaign activation.
Useful for understanding campaign scheduling and historical promotion sequencing.
Helps identify gaps or overlaps in promotional calendar planning.

Sort promotion results by campaign expiration date.

Orders promotions by their end_date field to see chronological campaign expiration.
Useful for managing promotion renewals and identifying upcoming campaign endings.
Supports proactive campaign management and continuity planning.

Sort promotion results by importance priority level.

Orders promotions by their priority field to see campaigns by importance ranking.
Useful for resource allocation and focusing on high-priority marketing initiatives.
Helps administrators prioritize campaign management efforts effectively.

Sort promotion results by creation timestamp.

Orders promotions by their created_at field to see historical creation sequence.
Useful for understanding promotion development timeline and creation patterns.
Provides insights into campaign planning and administrative workflow.

order_by.description:
Field selection for sorting promotion search results.

Specifies which promotion attribute to use as the primary sorting criterion.
Determines the organizational structure of returned promotion lists.

Supported sorting fields include name, promotion_type, start_date, end_date,
priority, and created_at for comprehensive campaign management flexibility.
Each sorting option provides different perspectives on promotion organization.

oneOf.description:
Sort promotion results in ascending order (A-Z, oldest-first, lowest-first).

Ascending order typically shows alphabetical A-Z, chronological oldest-first,
or numerical lowest-first values depending on the selected order_by field.
Useful for standard alphabetical browsing or historical chronological viewing.
Provides predictable ordering for systematic promotion review and analysis.

Sort promotion results in descending order (Z-A, newest-first, highest-first).

Descending order typically shows alphabetical Z-A, chronological newest-first,
or numerical highest-first values depending on the selected order_by field.
Useful for highlighting recent promotions or high-priority campaigns first.
Prioritizes current and important promotions for immediate administrative attention.

order_direction.description:
Sorting direction specification for promotion result organization.

Determines whether results appear in ascending (forward) or descending (reverse) order.
Ascending order shows values from low to high, while descending shows high to low.

Combined with order_by field to create comprehensive sorting strategies for promotion
management. Different combinations support various administrative workflow needs.

IShoppingMallPromotion.IRequest.description:
Search criteria and pagination parameters for comprehensive promotion filtering.

Contains all available filtering options for searching marketing promotions across the shopping mall platform.
Supports complex filtering by promotion type, active status, date ranges, priority levels, and channel associations.
Used by platform administrators to search and manage promotional campaigns with precise control and flexibility.

Advanced filtering capabilities enable administrators to:
- Target specific promotion categories (sale, clearance, loyalty, seasonal)
- Filter by active/inactive status for campaign management
- Set precise date ranges for historical analysis and future planning
- Prioritize high-importance promotions using priority levels
- Focus on specific sales channels for targeted marketing

The search functionality integrates with pagination parameters (page, limit) for efficient
handling of large promotion datasets. Sorting options (order_by, order_direction) provide
flexible result organization based on administrative needs and workflow preferences.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the coin account record.

Primary key generated automatically using UUID v4 format.
Provides globally unique identification for each coin account instance.
Used for secure reference in API operations and database relationships.

UUID format ensures collision-free identification across distributed systems.
Maintains referential integrity in polymorphic actor relationships.

actor_type.description:
Type of actor owning the coin account for polymorphic relationship management.

Valid values: customer, seller, administrator representing different platform user types.
Determines which actor table contains the related ownership record.
Enables efficient filtering and querying by actor category.

Essential for proper polymorphic relationship resolution in API responses.
Maintains data integrity across multiple actor type implementations.

balance.description:
Current available coin balance representing spendable digital currency.

Must be non-negative integer value representing available coins for transactions.
Updated automatically through coin transactions (earnings and spending operations).
Reflects real-time available balance for purchasing and reward redemption.

Negative balances are prevented by system validation rules.
Balance changes are audited through transaction history records.

total_earned.description:
Total cumulative coins earned through all historical transactions.

Represents lifetime earnings from purchases, rewards, bonuses, and other sources.
Incremented whenever coins are added to the account through any earning mechanism.
Provides historical perspective on account activity and earning patterns.

Useful for loyalty program tracking and customer lifetime value analysis.
Separate from balance to distinguish earned vs available amounts.

total_spent.description:
Total cumulative coins spent through all historical transactions.

Represents lifetime spending on purchases, fees, and other coin deductions.
Incremented whenever coins are deducted from the account through spending.
Provides comprehensive spending history for account analysis and reporting.

Helps track coin utilization patterns and spending behavior over time.
Essential for financial reconciliation and audit trail maintenance.

coin_type.description:
Type of digital currency represented by this coin account.

Examples: loyalty_points (customer reward points), reward_coins (seller incentives),
bonus_coins (promotional currency), referral_coins (referral program rewards).
Determines the currency rules, redemption options, and value calculations.

Different coin types may have separate earning rules and spending limitations.
Supports multiple currency systems within the same platform infrastructure.

oneOf.description:
Customer actor reference for coin account ownership context.

References the specific customer who owns this coin account.
Provides complete customer context including name, status, and identification.
Enables customer-specific coin management and personalized reward programs.

Customer coin accounts typically represent loyalty points and purchase rewards.
Supports customer engagement through personalized incentive programs.

Seller actor reference for coin account ownership context.

References the specific seller business that owns this coin account.
Provides complete seller context including business name and contact information.
Enables seller-specific coin management and business incentive programs.

Seller coin accounts typically represent business rewards and platform incentives.
Supports seller engagement through performance-based reward systems.

Administrator actor reference for coin account ownership context.

References the specific administrator who owns this coin account.
Provides complete administrator context including role and contact information.
Enables administrator-specific coin management and system reward programs.

Administrator coin accounts typically represent system credits and testing funds.
Supports platform administration through controlled currency allocation.

actor.description:
Polymorphic actor reference for coin account ownership resolution.

References the specific actor (customer, seller, or administrator) who owns this coin account.
Uses discriminator pattern with actor_type field to handle polymorphic types safely.
Provides complete actor context without requiring additional API calls for relationship resolution.

Enables efficient coin management across different platform user types with consistent interface.
Maintains data integrity while supporting flexible ownership models for digital currency.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when the coin account was initially created in the system.

Records the exact date and time when the coin account was established.
Used for account age calculation, historical tracking, and audit trail purposes.
ISO 8601 format ensures consistent datetime representation across systems.

Helps track account lifecycle and identify recently created accounts for onboarding.
Essential for compliance with financial reporting and data retention requirements.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp of the most recent balance update or account modification.

Records the last time any coin account field was updated, including balance changes.
Used for tracking account activity and identifying recent modifications.
ISO 8601 format ensures accurate datetime tracking for synchronization.

Helps identify active accounts and monitor recent transaction activity.
Essential for real-time balance synchronization and conflict resolution.

deleted_at.description:
Timestamp when the coin account was soft deleted for archival purposes.

Records when the account was marked for deletion using soft deletion pattern.
Null value indicates active account, while non-null indicates deleted state.
Supports account recovery and historical data preservation requirements.

Maintains transaction history while removing account from active operations.
Essential for compliance with data retention policies and audit requirements.

IShoppingMallCoin.description:
Main entity for digital currency balances with comprehensive polymorphic ownership support.

Tracks coin balances for platform users across multiple actor types (customers, sellers, administrators).
Each record represents a specific actor's coin account with current balance, lifetime earnings,
and spending metrics for complete financial tracking. The entity supports multiple coin types
with separate balances per actor, enabling flexible digital currency management.

Uses actor_type field for efficient filtering and polymorphic actor reference for proper
relationship modeling. Balances are updated through transaction records to ensure audit
trail integrity and financial accuracy. Soft deletion allows for account closure while
preserving transaction history for compliance and reporting purposes.

The main entity contains shared business attributes while subtype entities handle
actor-specific relationships and metadata. Coin accounts support various digital
currency types including loyalty points, reward coins, and promotional bonuses
with separate earning rules and spending limitations for each currency type.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the coin account. Generated automatically using UUID v4 format.

Serves as the primary key for the shopping_mall_coins table and is used for all coin account operations. This identifier remains constant throughout the account lifecycle and cannot be modified after creation.

actor_type.description:
Type of actor owning the coin account. Valid values: customer, seller, administrator.

This field implements polymorphic ownership support, allowing coin accounts to be associated with different types of platform users. The actor_type determines which subsidiary table (coin_of_customers, coin_of_sellers, coin_of_administrators) contains the specific actor relationship.

Required for proper scoping of coin account operations and ensures data integrity through the composite unique constraint with coin_type.

balance.description:
Current available coin balance representing the spendable digital currency amount.

Must be non-negative and reflects the net result of all earned and spent transactions. The balance is automatically updated through coin transaction records to maintain audit trail integrity.

Used for spending validations, account status checks, and financial reporting. Administrators can monitor balances for suspicious activity or account health assessments.

coin_type.description:
Type of digital currency managed by this account. Examples: loyalty_points, reward_coins, bonus_coins.

Supports multiple coin types within the platform, each with potentially different earning rules, spending policies, and conversion rates. The coin_type combined with actor_type forms a composite unique constraint ensuring each actor has only one account per coin type.

Required for proper coin type identification and supports platform-wide currency management.

total_earned.description:
Total coins earned through all transactions since account creation.

Represents the cumulative inflow of coins from various earning activities such as purchases, promotions, rewards, and bonuses. This metric provides insights into user engagement and platform activity.

Used for reporting, analytics, and understanding user behavior patterns. Must be non-negative and always greater than or equal to the current balance.

total_spent.description:
Total coins spent through all transactions since account creation.

Represents the cumulative outflow of coins used for purchases, redemptions, and other spending activities. This metric helps track user spending patterns and platform utilization.

Used for financial reporting, user analytics, and understanding coin circulation within the platform. Must be non-negative and always less than or equal to total_earned.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when the coin account was originally created in the system.

Uses ISO 8601 date-time format for consistent time representation across the platform. This timestamp is automatically set during account creation and remains immutable throughout the account lifecycle.

Used for account age calculations, reporting period filtering, and audit trail purposes. Helps identify new accounts and track account creation trends.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp of the last balance update or account modification.

Uses ISO 8601 date-time format and is automatically updated whenever the coin balance changes or account properties are modified. Provides visibility into account activity and recent changes.

Used for identifying recently active accounts, detecting stale accounts, and supporting time-based filtering in administrative reports.

IShoppingMallCoin.ISummary.description:
